name: gamma_source_scale_violation
statement:
theorem gamma_source_scale_violation
    (gp : GlobalParams)
    (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp)
    (B e : ℝ) (hB : B > 0) (_he : e ≥ 0)
    (_hB_eq : gp.B = B) (_he_eq : gp.e = e)
    (m : ℕ) (_hm_eq : gp.m = m) (_hm_pos : m > 0)
    (h_denom_pos : (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) *
        ((↑(Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)) : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1) > 0)
    (h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta)
    (h_bsns_large : QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r >
        (B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 *
          ((↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) *
           ((↑(Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)) : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1))) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
      if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩)
      else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
    (hInv_inst : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)) →
    gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst / Real.sqrt (↑(gp.m + 1) * (↑n₀ - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1)) > B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst
  have h_alpha_pos := gp.halpha
  have h_inv_block : Invertible (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedBlock gp.R_beta gp.z gp.eta_p) := by
    apply Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet
    have h_zero : (fun (_ : Fin 1) (_ : Fin gp.m) => (0 : ℝ)) = (0 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin gp.m) ℝ) := by
      ext; simp
    simp only [QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedBlock, h_zero]
    rw [Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · haveI := h_inv_R
      exact ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (isUnit_of_invertible gp.R_beta)).ne_zero
    · rw [Matrix.det_fin_one]
      simp only [GlobalParams.eta_p, GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d, GlobalParams.epsilon,
        GlobalParams.tau_0]
      exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num))
        (mul_pos h_alpha_pos (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)))
  have h_r_eq : gp.r = gp.eta_p ^ 2 := by
    change GlobalParams.tau_0 * gp.d_m ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt GlobalParams.tau_0 * gp.d_m) ^ 2
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ GlobalParams.tau_0 by
      unfold GlobalParams.tau_0; norm_num)]
  have h_r_pos : gp.r > 0 := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d, GlobalParams.epsilon]
    exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (sq_pos_of_pos (mul_pos h_alpha_pos (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)))
  have h_L4 := QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.lemma4_selected_block_pressure
    gp.R_beta gp.z gp.eta_p gp.r h_r_eq h_r_pos h_inv_R h_inv_block
  set L4sel := QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix gp.R_beta gp.z gp.eta_p with hL4sel_def
  have h_matrix_eq : selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀ =
      L4sel.submatrix (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) := by
    ext t j
    simp only [selectedMatrix, Matrix.submatrix, id]
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ t <;> refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · simp only [Matrix.of_apply, pivots₀,
        show ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) from by simp [Fin.last],
        dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        A, GlobalParams.a_p, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, L4sel,
        QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedBlock,
        Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂]
    · intro j'
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply, pivots₀,
        show ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) from by simp [Fin.last],
        dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
        A, GlobalParams.a_p,
        show (j'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 j' from rfl,
        show ((Fin.castAdd 1 j').val < gp.m) from j'.isLt,
        dif_pos, Fin.castLT, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd,
        L4sel, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedBlock,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂]
      simp only [Fin.val_castAdd]
    · intro t'
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply,
        show (t'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 t' from rfl,
        pivots₀, show ((Fin.castAdd 1 t').val < gp.m) from t'.isLt, dif_pos,
        Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_pq,
        show ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) from by simp [Fin.last],
        dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd, L4sel,
        QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedBlock,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁]
    · intro t' j'
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply,
        show (t'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 t' from rfl,
        show (j'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 j' from rfl,
        pivots₀, show ((Fin.castAdd 1 t').val < gp.m) from t'.isLt,
        show ((Fin.castAdd 1 j').val < gp.m) from j'.isLt, dif_pos,
        Q₀, Matrix.transpose_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_pq,
        finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd, L4sel,
        QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedMatrix, QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.selectedBlock,
        Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
      exact congrArg₂ gp.R_beta (Fin.ext rfl) (Fin.ext rfl)
  have h_inv_eq : (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ =
      (L4sel)⁻¹.submatrix (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) (⇑finSumFinEquiv.symm) := by
    rw [h_matrix_eq, Matrix.inv_submatrix_equiv]
  have h_gamma_lower : gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst ≥
      Real.sqrt (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r) :=
    NormBridge.gamma_ge_of_inv_submatrix L4sel⁻¹ _ h_L4 Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst h_inv_eq
  set denom := (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) * ((↑n₀ : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1) with h_denom_def
  have h_bsns_over_r_pos : QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r > 0 :=
    lt_trans (by positivity) h_bsns_large
  rw [gt_iff_lt, ← sub_pos]
  have h1 : gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv_inst / Real.sqrt denom
      - B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e ≥
      Real.sqrt (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r) /
        Real.sqrt denom
      - B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e := by
    apply sub_le_sub_right
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_gamma_lower (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  suffices h2 : Real.sqrt (QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r) /
      Real.sqrt denom
      > B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e by linarith
  rw [← Real.sqrt_div (le_of_lt h_bsns_over_r_pos)]
  have hBke_nonneg : B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e ≥ 0 := by positivity
  rw [show B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e =
      Real.sqrt ((B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2) from
    (Real.sqrt_sq hBke_nonneg).symm]
  apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos]
  linarith [h_bsns_large]

name: z_sq_le_d_sq
statement:
private lemma z_sq_le_d_sq (gp : GlobalParams) (i : Fin gp.m) :
    gp.z i ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 16) * gp.d i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold z gamma_0 tau_0 d
  split_ifs with hi
  · have hsi := gp.sigma_sq i
    have hs1 := gp.s_le_one
    have hcalc : (1 / 4 * gp.sigma i * gp.s * (gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ i.val)) ^ 2 =
        (1 / 16) * (gp.sigma i ^ 2) * (gp.s ^ 2) * (gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ i.val) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hcalc, hsi]
    have : gp.s ^ 2 ≤ 1 := (sq_le_one_iff₀ gp.s_nonneg.le).mpr hs1
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ i.val)]
  · have hsi := gp.sigma_sq i
    have h_sq : Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) ^ 2 = 15 / 16 := by
      rw [show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / 16 = 15 / 16 from by ring]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hcalc : (1 / 4 * gp.sigma i * Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) * (gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ i.val)) ^ 2 =
        (1 / 16) * (gp.sigma i ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) ^ 2) * (gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ i.val) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hcalc, hsi, h_sq]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ i.val)]

name: kappa_z_eq_two
statement: private lemma kappa_z_eq_two : kappa_z = 2
proof: := by unfold kappa_z; norm_num

name: sum_d_sq_le_m_alpha_sq
statement:
private lemma sum_d_sq_le_m_alpha_sq (gp : GlobalParams) :
    ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 ≤ ↑gp.m * gp.alpha ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ _i : Fin gp.m, gp.alpha ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => gp.d_sq_le i)
    _ = ↑gp.m * gp.alpha ^ 2 := by simp [Finset.sum_const, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: sum_d_sq_le_alpha_sq_div_s_sq
statement:
private lemma sum_d_sq_le_alpha_sq_div_s_sq (gp : GlobalParams) (hs_pos : gp.s ^ 2 > 0) :
    ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 ≤ gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd_form : ∀ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2 * (gp.epsilon ^ 2) ^ i.val := by
    intro i; unfold d; rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]; ring_nf
  have heps2_lt : gp.epsilon ^ 2 < 1 := by have := gp.s_sq; linarith
  have heps2_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ gp.epsilon ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  calc ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2
      = gp.alpha ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, (gp.epsilon ^ 2) ^ i.val := by
        simp_rw [hd_form]; rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = gp.alpha ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range gp.m, (gp.epsilon ^ 2) ^ i := by
        congr 1; rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    _ ≤ gp.alpha ^ 2 * (1 / (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg _)
        have h_sub_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2 := by linarith
        rw [le_div_iff₀ h_sub_pos]
        have hgeom := geom_sum_mul_of_le_one heps2_lt.le gp.m
        
        linarith [pow_nonneg heps2_nn gp.m]
    _ = gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2 := by rw [gp.s_sq]; ring

name: trace_RRt_eq_sum_sq
statement:
private lemma trace_RRt_eq_sum_sq (gp : GlobalParams) :
    (gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose).trace = ∑ i : Fin gp.m, ∑ j : Fin gp.m, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, mul_apply, transpose_apply, sq]

name: trace_le_factor_sum_d_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_RRt_eq_sum_sq]
  have h_row : ∀ i : Fin gp.m,
      ∑ j : Fin gp.m, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2 ≤ gp.d i ^ 2 * (1 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) := by
    intro i
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    have h_diag : gp.R_beta i i ^ 2 = gp.d i ^ 2 := by unfold R_beta; simp [sq]
    rw [h_diag]
    have h_off : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2 ≤ gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * gp.d i ^ 2 := by
      intro j hj
      have hij : i ≠ j := (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm
      unfold R_beta
      simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte, sq]
      split_ifs with h2
      · have hsi := gp.sigma_sq i; have hsj := gp.sigma_sq j
        have hcalc : -beta * gp.sigma i * gp.sigma j * gp.s * gp.d i *
            (-beta * gp.sigma i * gp.sigma j * gp.s * gp.d i) =
            (1/4) * (gp.sigma i ^ 2) * (gp.sigma j ^ 2) * gp.s ^ 2 * gp.d i ^ 2 := by
          unfold beta; ring
        rw [hcalc, hsi, hsj]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg gp.s, sq_nonneg (gp.d i)]
      · nlinarith [sq_nonneg gp.s, sq_nonneg (gp.d i)]
    have h_card : (Finset.univ.erase i).card = gp.m - 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]; simp [Fintype.card_fin]
    have h_sum_le : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2 ≤
        (↑gp.m - 1) * (gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * gp.d i ^ 2) := by
      calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2
          ≤ (Finset.univ.erase i).card • (gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * gp.d i ^ 2) :=
            Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ h_off
        _ = ↑(Finset.univ.erase i).card * (gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * gp.d i ^ 2) := nsmul_eq_mul _ _
        _ = (↑gp.m - 1) * (gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * gp.d i ^ 2) := by
            rw [h_card, Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ gp.m from gp.hm)]; simp
    linarith
  calc ∑ i : Fin gp.m, ∑ j : Fin gp.m, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ i : Fin gp.m, (gp.d i ^ 2 * (1 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_row i)
    _ = (1 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul]; ring_nf

name: RtransX_sq_le_trace_mul_norm
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_RRt_eq_sum_sq]
  calc ∑ j, (∑ i, gp.R_beta i j * x i) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ j, (∑ i, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2) * (∑ i, x i ^ 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _)
    _ = (∑ j, ∑ i, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2) * (∑ i, x i ^ 2) := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = (∑ i, ∑ j, gp.R_beta i j ^ 2) * (∑ i, x i ^ 2) := by congr 1; rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: combined_bound_lt_one
statement:
private lemma combined_bound_lt_one (gp : GlobalParams)
    (h_alpha_m_small : gp.alpha ^ 2 * ↑gp.m ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hm_ge2 : gp.m ≥ 2) :
    (gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose).trace + kappa_z * (gp.z ⬝ᵥ gp.z) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz_dot : gp.z ⬝ᵥ gp.z = ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i ^ 2 := by simp [dotProduct, sq]
  rw [hz_dot, kappa_z_eq_two]
  have hz_le : ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 16) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 :=
    calc ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i ^ 2
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin gp.m, ((1 / 16) * gp.d i ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => z_sq_le_d_sq gp i)
      _ = (1 / 16) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hkz_z_le : 2 * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 8) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 := by linarith
  have h_trace_le := trace_le_factor_sum_d_sq gp
  have hd_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have h_combined_le : (gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose).trace + 2 * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i ^ 2 ≤
      (9 / 8 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have halpha_pos := gp.halpha
  have hsd := sum_d_sq_le_m_alpha_sq gp
  by_cases hcase : (↑gp.m - 1 : ℝ) * gp.s ^ 2 ≤ 1
  · 
    nlinarith
  · 
    simp only [not_le] at hcase
    have hm1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ↑gp.m - 1 := by
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ↑gp.m := Nat.ofNat_le_cast.mpr hm_ge2; linarith
    have hs_sq_pos : gp.s ^ 2 > 0 := by nlinarith
    have hd_geom := sum_d_sq_le_alpha_sq_div_s_sq gp hs_sq_pos
    have inv_s_sq_lt_m : 1 / gp.s ^ 2 < ↑gp.m := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hs_sq_pos]; nlinarith [gp.s_le_one]
    have hd_lt : gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2 < 1 / 4 := by
      calc gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2
          = gp.alpha ^ 2 * (1 / gp.s ^ 2) := by ring
        _ < gp.alpha ^ 2 * ↑gp.m := by
            apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left inv_s_sq_lt_m; positivity
        _ ≤ 1 / 4 := h_alpha_m_small
    have h_cancel : (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) =
        (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.alpha ^ 2 / 4 := by
      have hs_ne : gp.s ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_sq_pos
      rw [show (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) =
          (↑gp.m - 1) * (gp.s ^ 2 * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2)) / 4 from by ring,
          mul_div_cancel₀ _ hs_ne]
    have step1 : (9 / 8 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 ≤
        9 / 8 * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.alpha ^ 2 / 4 := by
      have h1 : (9 / 8 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2 ≤
          (9 / 8 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_geom; nlinarith
      calc (9 / 8 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.d i ^ 2
          ≤ (9 / 8 + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4) * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) := h1
        _ = 9 / 8 * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.s ^ 2 / 4 * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = 9 / 8 * (gp.alpha ^ 2 / gp.s ^ 2) + (↑gp.m - 1) * gp.alpha ^ 2 / 4 := by rw [h_cancel]
    nlinarith

name: M_rem_posDef
statement:
theorem M_rem_posDef (gp : GlobalParams)
    (h_sym : gp.M_rem.IsHermitian)
    (h_alpha_m_small : gp.alpha ^ 2 * ↑gp.m ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hm_ge2 : gp.m ≥ 2) :
    gp.M_rem.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos h_sym
  intro x hx
  simp only [star_trivial]
  
  have h_expand : x ⬝ᵥ (gp.M_rem *ᵥ x) =
      (x ⬝ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ ((gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose) *ᵥ x) -
      kappa_z * (x ⬝ᵥ (vecMulVec gp.z gp.z *ᵥ x)) := by
    unfold M_rem
    simp only [sub_mulVec, one_mulVec, smul_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h_expand]
  
  have h_RRtx : x ⬝ᵥ ((gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose) *ᵥ x) =
      ∑ j : Fin gp.m, (∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.R_beta i j * x i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, mulVec_transpose]
    simp only [dotProduct, vecMul, sq, Finset.sum_mul]
    congr 1; ext j; congr 1; ext i
    congr 1
    · ring
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _; ring
  
  have h_zzx : x ⬝ᵥ (vecMulVec gp.z gp.z *ᵥ x) = (∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i * x i) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [vecMulVec_mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop,
      MulOpposite.unop_op, sq]
    have : ∀ i : Fin gp.m, x i * (gp.z i * ∑ j, gp.z j * x j) =
        gp.z i * x i * ∑ j, gp.z j * x j := fun i => by ring
    simp_rw [this, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [h_RRtx, h_zzx]
  have h_norm_x : x ⬝ᵥ x = ∑ i : Fin gp.m, x i ^ 2 := by simp [dotProduct, sq]
  rw [h_norm_x]
  
  have hx_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ∑ i : Fin gp.m, x i ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (x j))
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x i ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h; simp only [not_exists, ne_eq, not_not] at h; exact hx (funext h)
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, by positivity⟩
  
  have hcb := combined_bound_lt_one gp h_alpha_m_small hm_ge2
  have h_Rt_bound := RtransX_sq_le_trace_mul_norm gp x
  have h_z_bound : (∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i * x i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i ^ 2) * ∑ i : Fin gp.m, x i ^ 2 :=
    sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
  have hz_dot : gp.z ⬝ᵥ gp.z = ∑ i : Fin gp.m, gp.z i ^ 2 := by simp [dotProduct, sq]
  
  have h_neg_bound : ∑ j, (∑ i, gp.R_beta i j * x i) ^ 2 + kappa_z * (∑ i, gp.z i * x i) ^ 2 ≤
      ((gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose).trace + kappa_z * (gp.z ⬝ᵥ gp.z)) *
      ∑ i : Fin gp.m, x i ^ 2 := by
    rw [hz_dot, add_mul]
    apply add_le_add h_Rt_bound
    rw [mul_assoc]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_z_bound
    rw [kappa_z_eq_two]; norm_num
  
  nlinarith

name: M_rem_eigenvalues_pos
statement:
theorem M_rem_eigenvalues_pos (gp : GlobalParams) (h_sym : gp.M_rem.IsHermitian)
    (h_pd : gp.M_rem.PosDef) (h : Fin gp.m) : h_sym.eigenvalues h > 0
proof:
:=
  h_pd.eigenvalues_pos h

name: coherence_product_bound
statement:
theorem coherence_product_bound
    (gp : GlobalParams)
    (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    (hQTQ : Q₀.transpose * Q₀ = 1) →
    (heta_bound : Real.exp (2 * gp.eta) < gp.H_star) →
    (h_alpha_small : 5 * gp.alpha ^ 2 < gp.H_star -
        Real.exp (2 * gp.eta)) →
    (h_mu_le : (↑n₀ : ℝ) / (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) *
        (⨆ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), (Q₀ i j) ^ 2) ≤
        Real.exp (2 * gp.eta) + 5 * gp.alpha ^ 2) →
    [Nonempty (Fin n₀)] →
    mu Q₀ < gp.H_star := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ _hQTQ heta_bound h_alpha_small h_mu_le _
  unfold mu
  linarith

name: gamma_eq_inv_sqrt_min_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem gamma_eq_inv_sqrt_min_eigenvalue
    (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (pivots : Fin k → Fin n)
    [DecidableEq (Fin k)] [Nonempty (Fin k)] (hNonsingular : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q pivots)) :
    gamma Q pivots hNonsingular =
      1 / Real.sqrt (⨅ (i : Fin k), (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self
        (selectedMatrix Q pivots)).eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  
  set M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ := selectedMatrix Q pivots with hM_def
  
  have hH : (M.conjTranspose * M).IsHermitian :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self M
  
  simp only [gamma]
  rw [← hM_def]
  exact norm_inv_eq_inv_sqrt_min_eigenvalue M

name: exists_qrcp_pivot_sequence
statement:
theorem exists_qrcp_pivot_sequence
    (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hOrtho : Q.transpose * Q = 1) :
    ∃ (pivots : Fin k → Fin n), IsQRCPPivotSequence Q pivots
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst hk
    exact ⟨Fin.elim0, fun t => t.elim0⟩
  
  have hk_pos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
  
  have hkn : k ≤ n := by
    have h := le_trans (le_trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le Q.transpose Q)
      (min_le_right ..)) (Matrix.rank_le_height Q)
    rwa [hOrtho, Matrix.rank_one, Fintype.card_fin] at h
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := by omega
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hn_pos⟩
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn_pos⟩⟩
  
  
  have step : ∀ (S : List (Fin n)), S.Nodup → S.length < n →
      ∃ next : Fin n, next ∉ S ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin n), i ∉ S →
          residualScore Q i S ≤ residualScore Q next S ∧
          (residualScore Q i S = residualScore Q next S → next.val ≤ i.val) := by
    intro S hSNodup hSlen
    let unselected : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ \ S.toFinset
    have h_un_card : unselected.card = n - S.length := by
      rw [Finset.card_univ_diff, Fintype.card_fin, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hSNodup]
    have h_un_ne : unselected.Nonempty := by
      apply Finset.card_pos.mp
      rw [h_un_card]; omega
    obtain ⟨m, hm_mem, hm_max⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_max_image unselected (fun i => residualScore Q i S) h_un_ne
    let maxers : Finset (Fin n) :=
      unselected.filter (fun i => residualScore Q i S = residualScore Q m S)
    have h_max_ne : maxers.Nonempty :=
      ⟨m, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hm_mem, rfl⟩⟩
    let next : Fin n := maxers.min' h_max_ne
    have h_next_in_maxers : next ∈ maxers := maxers.min'_mem h_max_ne
    have h_next_un : next ∈ unselected := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h_next_in_maxers).1
    have h_next_score : residualScore Q next S = residualScore Q m S :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp h_next_in_maxers).2
    refine ⟨next, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hin
      have h_not_in : next ∉ S.toFinset := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp h_next_un).2
      exact h_not_in (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hin)
    · intro i hi
      have hi_un : i ∈ unselected := by
        rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, fun h => hi (List.mem_toFinset.mp h)⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h_next_score]; exact hm_max i hi_un
      · intro heq
        have hi_in_maxers : i ∈ maxers :=
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi_un, by rw [heq, h_next_score]⟩
        exact Finset.min'_le maxers i hi_in_maxers
  
  
  have build : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ k →
      ∃ L : List (Fin n), L.length = m ∧ L.Nodup ∧
        ∀ (j : ℕ) (hjm : j < m), ∀ (hjL : j < L.length),
          (L.get ⟨j, hjL⟩ ∉ L.take j) ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin n), i ∉ L.take j →
            residualScore Q i (L.take j) ≤ residualScore Q (L.get ⟨j, hjL⟩) (L.take j) ∧
            (residualScore Q i (L.take j) = residualScore Q (L.get ⟨j, hjL⟩) (L.take j) →
              (L.get ⟨j, hjL⟩).val ≤ i.val) := by
    intro m hm
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨[], rfl, List.nodup_nil, ?_⟩
      intro j hj _
      omega
    | succ m ih =>
      obtain ⟨L, hLen, hNodup, hProp⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨next, h_next_notin, h_next_prop⟩ :=
        step L hNodup (by rw [hLen]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hkn)
      refine ⟨L ++ [next], by simp [hLen], ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hNodup.append (List.nodup_singleton _) (by
          intro x hx hx_eq
          rw [List.mem_singleton] at hx_eq
          exact h_next_notin (hx_eq ▸ hx))
      · intro j hjm hjL
        by_cases hjm' : j < m
        · have hjL' : j < L.length := by omega
          rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (show j ≤ L.length by omega),
              show (L ++ [next]).get ⟨j, hjL⟩ = L.get ⟨j, hjL'⟩ from by
                simp [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_append_left hjL']]
          exact hProp j hjm' hjL'
        · 
          have hjm_eq : j = m := by omega
          subst hjm_eq
          have h_take : (L ++ [next]).take j = L := by
            rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by omega), ← hLen, List.take_length]
          have h_get : (L ++ [next]).get ⟨j, hjL⟩ = next := by
            rw [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_append_right (by omega : L.length ≤ j)]
            simp [hLen]
          rw [h_take, h_get]
          exact ⟨h_next_notin, h_next_prop⟩
  
  obtain ⟨L, hLen, hNodup, hProp⟩ := build k le_rfl
  
  set pivots : Fin k → Fin n := fun i => L.get ⟨i.val, by rw [hLen]; exact i.isLt⟩
    with hpivots_def
  
  have bridge : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ k → pivotPrefix pivots m = L.take m := by
    intro m hm
    induction m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      have hmk : m < k := hm
      simp only [pivotPrefix, hmk, dif_pos]
      rw [ih (Nat.le_of_lt hmk)]
      have hmL : m < L.length := by omega
      simp only [show pivots ⟨m, hmk⟩ = L.get ⟨m, hmL⟩ from by simp [hpivots_def],
                 List.get_eq_getElem, List.take_concat_get' L m hmL]
  refine ⟨pivots, ?_⟩
  intro t
  
  have h_St_eq : pivotPrefix pivots t.val = L.take t.val := bridge t.val (Nat.le_of_lt t.isLt)
  have htL : t.val < L.length := by rw [hLen]; exact t.isLt
  have h_pivot_eq : pivots t = L.get ⟨t.val, htL⟩ := by simp [hpivots_def]
  obtain ⟨h_not_in, h_score⟩ := hProp t.val t.isLt htL
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h_St_eq, h_pivot_eq]; exact h_not_in
  · intro i hi
    rw [h_St_eq] at hi
    rw [h_St_eq, h_pivot_eq]
    exact h_score i hi

name: parseval_QTQ_eq_one
statement:
theorem parseval_QTQ_eq_one
    (gp : GlobalParams)
    (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J))) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    Q₀.transpose * Q₀ = 1 := by
  intro eidx Q₀
  set AA := A gp decomp resP with hAA
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  change ∑ x, AA i (eidx.symm x) * AA j (eidx.symm x) = _
  rw [show ∑ x, AA i (eidx.symm x) * AA j (eidx.symm x)
      = ∑ c : ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J, AA i c * AA j c
    from Equiv.sum_comp eidx.symm (fun c => AA i c * AA j c)]
  rw [ColIndex.sum_eq]
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ i
  · 
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · 
      simp only [ite_true]
      have hl : ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) := by simp [Fin.last]
      have h_sel : ∑ q', AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.selected q') * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.selected q') = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro q' _
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_pq, hl, dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, mul_zero]
      have h_fc : AA (Fin.last gp.m) .finalSelected * AA (Fin.last gp.m) .finalSelected
          + ∑ idx : Fin 2, AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.cross idx) * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.cross idx)
          = GlobalParams.kappa_eta * gp.r := by
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_p, GlobalParams.a_cross, dif_neg hl,
          GlobalParams.eta_p, GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.tau_0, GlobalParams.kappa_eta,
          Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
        have hsq : Real.sqrt (1/16 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (1/16) = 1/16 :=
          Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
        nlinarith [hsq, sq_nonneg gp.d_m]
      have h_frame : ∑ h, AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.frame h) * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.frame h) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro h _
        simp only [AA, A, dif_neg hl, mul_zero]
      have h_res : ∑ j, AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.residual j) * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.residual j)
          = ∑ j : Fin resP.J, resP.theta j := by
        congr 1; ext j; simp only [AA, A, dif_neg hl]
        exact Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt (resP.htheta_pos j))
      linarith [h_sel, h_fc, h_frame, h_res, resP.hsum_theta]
    · 
      intro q'
      simp only [show Fin.last gp.m = Fin.castSucc q' ↔ False from
        ⟨fun h => absurd h.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last q'), False.elim⟩, ite_false]
      have hl : ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) := by simp [Fin.last]
      have hq : (↑(Fin.castAdd 1 q') : ℕ) < gp.m := q'.isLt
      have hqc : (Fin.castAdd 1 q').castLT hq = q' := Fin.ext rfl
      simp_rw [show (q'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 q' from rfl]
      have h_sel : ∑ q'', AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.selected q'') * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.selected q'') = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro q'' _
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_pq, hl, dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, zero_mul]
      have h_fc : AA (Fin.last gp.m) .finalSelected * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') .finalSelected
          + ∑ idx : Fin 2, AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.cross idx) * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.cross idx) = 0 := by
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_p, GlobalParams.a_cross, dif_pos hq, dif_neg hl, hqc]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]; ring
      have h_frame : ∑ h, AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.frame h) * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.frame h) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro h _
        simp only [AA, A, dif_neg hl, zero_mul]
      have h_res : ∑ j, AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.residual j) * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.residual j) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _; simp only [AA, A, dif_neg hl, dif_pos hq]; ring
      linarith [h_sel, h_fc, h_frame, h_res]
  · 
    intro p'
    have hip : (p'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 p' := rfl
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
    · 
      simp only [show Fin.castSucc p' = Fin.last gp.m ↔ False from
        ⟨fun h => absurd h (Fin.castSucc_ne_last p'), False.elim⟩, ite_false]
      have hp : (↑(Fin.castAdd 1 p') : ℕ) < gp.m := p'.isLt
      have hl : ¬((Fin.last gp.m : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m) := by simp [Fin.last]
      have hpc : (Fin.castAdd 1 p').castLT hp = p' := Fin.ext rfl
      simp_rw [hip]
      have h_sel : ∑ q', AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.selected q') * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.selected q') = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro q' _
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_pq, hl, dif_neg, not_false_eq_true, mul_zero]
      have h_fc : AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') .finalSelected * AA (Fin.last gp.m) .finalSelected
          + ∑ idx : Fin 2, AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.cross idx) * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.cross idx) = 0 := by
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_p, GlobalParams.a_cross, dif_pos hp, dif_neg hl, hpc]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]; ring
      have h_frame : ∑ h, AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.frame h) * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.frame h) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro h _
        simp only [AA, A, dif_pos hp, dif_neg hl]; ring
      have h_res : ∑ j, AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.residual j) * AA (Fin.last gp.m) (.residual j) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _; simp only [AA, A, dif_pos hp]; ring
      linarith [h_sel, h_fc, h_frame, h_res]
    · 
      intro q'
      have hp : (↑(Fin.castAdd 1 p') : ℕ) < gp.m := p'.isLt
      have hq : (↑(Fin.castAdd 1 q') : ℕ) < gp.m := q'.isLt
      have hpc : (Fin.castAdd 1 p').castLT hp = p' := Fin.ext rfl
      have hqc : (Fin.castAdd 1 q').castLT hq = q' := Fin.ext rfl
      have hjq : (q'.castSucc : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 q' := rfl
      simp_rw [hip, hjq]
      have h_if : (if Fin.castAdd 1 p' = Fin.castAdd 1 q' then (1:ℝ) else 0)
          = if p' = q' then 1 else 0 := by
        by_cases h : p' = q'
        · subst h; simp
        · simp [h, show Fin.castAdd 1 p' ≠ Fin.castAdd 1 q' from
            fun heq => h (Fin.ext (by simpa [Fin.ext_iff] using heq))]
      rw [h_if]
      have h_sel : ∑ q'', AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.selected q'') * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.selected q'')
          = (gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose) p' q' := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]; congr 1; ext q''
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_pq, dif_pos hp, dif_pos hq, hpc, hqc]
      have h_fc : AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') .finalSelected * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') .finalSelected
          + ∑ idx : Fin 2, AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.cross idx) * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.cross idx)
          = 2 * (gp.z p' * gp.z q') := by
        simp only [AA, A, GlobalParams.a_p, GlobalParams.a_cross, dif_pos hp, dif_pos hq, hpc, hqc]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]; ring
      have h_frame : ∑ h, AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.frame h) * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.frame h)
          = gp.M_rem p' q' := by
        simp only [AA, A, dif_pos hp, dif_pos hq, hpc, hqc]
        conv_rhs => rw [decomp.hdecomp p' q']
        congr 1; ext h
        have hsq : Real.sqrt (decomp.W h) * Real.sqrt (decomp.W h) = decomp.W h :=
          Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt (decomp.hW_pos h))
        linear_combination (decomp.u h p' * decomp.u h q') * hsq
      have h_res : ∑ j, AA (Fin.castAdd 1 p') (.residual j) * AA (Fin.castAdd 1 q') (.residual j) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _; simp only [AA, A, dif_pos hp]; ring
      have h_Mdef : gp.M_rem p' q' = (if p' = q' then 1 else 0)
          - (gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose) p' q' - 2 * (gp.z p' * gp.z q') := by
        simp only [GlobalParams.M_rem, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
          Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
        unfold GlobalParams.kappa_z; ring
      linarith [h_sel, h_fc, h_frame, h_res, h_Mdef]

name: Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos
statement: lemma Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : n > 0) : n - 1 < n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => linarith
  | succ n => simp

name: epsilon_le_one
statement: lemma epsilon_le_one : p.epsilon ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold epsilon; rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
  exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith [p.heta_pos]) (by positivity)

name: epsilon_pos'
statement: lemma epsilon_pos' : p.epsilon > 0
proof: := Real.exp_pos _

name: s_le_one
statement: lemma s_le_one : p.s ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold s; rw [Real.sqrt_le_one]; nlinarith [p.epsilon_le_one]

name: s_nonneg
statement: lemma s_nonneg : p.s ≥ 0
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: one_sub_epsilon_sq_nonneg
statement: lemma one_sub_epsilon_sq_nonneg : 1 - p.epsilon ^ 2 ≥ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := p.epsilon_le_one
  have h2 := p.epsilon_pos'
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - p.epsilon)]

name: s_sq
statement: lemma s_sq : p.s ^ 2 = 1 - p.epsilon ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold s; exact Real.sq_sqrt p.one_sub_epsilon_sq_nonneg.le

name: s_sq_le
statement: lemma s_sq_le : p.s ^ 2 ≤ 2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [p.s_sq]
  have h_eps_sq : p.epsilon ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)) := by
    unfold epsilon
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, show (2 : ℕ) = 2 from rfl]
    congr 1; push_cast; field_simp
  rw [h_eps_sq]
  have harg : -(2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)) = -2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1) := by ring
  have key := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)))
  rw [harg] at key; linarith

name: d_le_alpha
statement: lemma d_le_alpha (i : Fin p.m) : p.d i ≤ p.alpha
proof:
:= by
  unfold d
  have : p.alpha * p.epsilon ^ i.val ≤ p.alpha * 1 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (le_of_lt p.epsilon_pos') p.epsilon_le_one) (le_of_lt p.halpha)
  linarith

name: d_pos'
statement: lemma d_pos' (i : Fin p.m) : p.d i > 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold d; exact mul_pos p.halpha (pow_pos p.epsilon_pos' _)

name: sigma_sq
statement: lemma sigma_sq (i : Fin p.m) : p.sigma i ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases p.hsigma i with
  | inl h => rw [h]; ring
  | inr h => rw [h]; ring

name: d_sq_le
statement: lemma d_sq_le (i : Fin p.m) : p.d i ^ 2 ≤ p.alpha ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sq_le_sq' (by linarith [p.d_pos' i, p.d_le_alpha i]) (p.d_le_alpha i)

name: m_sub_one_mul_s_sq_le
statement: lemma m_sub_one_mul_s_sq_le : (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 ≤ 2 * p.eta
proof:
:= by
  have hs := p.s_sq_le
  have hm1_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ↑p.m - 1 := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ↑p.m := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr p.hm; linarith
  calc (↑p.m - 1 : ℝ) * p.s ^ 2
      ≤ (↑p.m - 1) * (2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hm1_nn
    _ ≤ (↑p.m + 1) * (2 * p.eta / (↑p.m + 1)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith)
        exact div_nonneg (by linarith [p.heta_pos]) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * p.eta := by field_simp

name: R_off_diag_sq
statement:
private lemma R_off_diag_sq (i j : Fin p.m) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j ≤ p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hR : p.R_beta i j = if i = j then p.d i
      else if i.val < j.val then -beta * p.sigma i * p.sigma j * p.s * p.d i
      else 0 := rfl
  rw [hR, if_neg hij]
  split_ifs with h2
  · have hsi := p.sigma_sq i; have hsj := p.sigma_sq j
    have calc1 : -beta * p.sigma i * p.sigma j * p.s * p.d i *
      (-beta * p.sigma i * p.sigma j * p.s * p.d i) =
      (1/4) * (p.sigma i ^ 2) * (p.sigma j ^ 2) * p.s ^ 2 * p.d i ^ 2 := by
      unfold beta; ring
    rw [calc1, hsi, hsj]
    nlinarith [p.d_sq_le i, sq_nonneg p.s]
  · simp only [zero_mul]; positivity

name: R_diag_sq
statement:
private lemma R_diag_sq (i : Fin p.m) :
    p.R_beta i i * p.R_beta i i ≤ p.alpha ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have : p.R_beta i i = p.d i := by unfold R_beta; simp
  rw [this]; linarith [p.d_sq_le i, sq_nonneg (p.d i)]

name: row_sq_sum_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  apply add_le_add
  · exact p.R_diag_sq i
  · have h_card : (Finset.univ.erase i).card = p.m - 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]; simp [Fintype.card_fin]
    calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j
        ≤ (Finset.univ.erase i).card • (p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ (fun j hj => p.R_off_diag_sq i j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj).symm)
      _ = ↑(Finset.univ.erase i).card * (p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2) := nsmul_eq_mul _ _
      _ = (↑p.m - 1) * (p.s ^ 2 / 4 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
          rw [h_card, Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ p.m from p.hm)]
          simp

name: R_beta_trace_le
statement:
lemma R_beta_trace_le :
    (p.R_beta * p.R_beta.transpose).trace ≤ ↑p.m * p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + p.eta / 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  unfold trace diag
  simp only [mul_apply, transpose_apply]
  
  have h_row : ∀ i : Fin p.m,
      ∑ j : Fin p.m, p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j ≤
      p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 4) := by
    intro i
    have := p.row_sq_sum_le i
    linarith
  
  calc ∑ i : Fin p.m, ∑ j : Fin p.m, p.R_beta i j * p.R_beta i j
      ≤ ∑ _i : Fin p.m, (p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 4)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h_row i)
    _ = ↑p.m * (p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 4)) := by
        simp [Finset.sum_const, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ↑p.m * (p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + p.eta / 2)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        linarith [p.m_sub_one_mul_s_sq_le]
    _ = ↑p.m * p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + p.eta / 2) := by ring

name: kz_z_norm_sq_le
statement:
lemma kz_z_norm_sq_le :
    kappa_z * (p.z ⬝ᵥ p.z) ≤ p.alpha ^ 2 * (p.eta / 4 + 15 / 128)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hkz : kappa_z = 2 := by unfold kappa_z; norm_num
  rw [hkz]
  
  unfold dotProduct
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hz_entry : ∀ i : Fin p.m, p.z i * p.z i ≤
      if i.val < p.m - 1 then p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2
      else 15 / 256 * p.alpha ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    unfold z gamma_0 tau_0
    split_ifs with hi
    · 
      have hsi := p.sigma_sq i
      have hdi := p.d_sq_le i
      have hs0 := p.s_nonneg
      have : (1 : ℝ) / 4 * p.sigma i * p.s * p.d i * (1 / 4 * p.sigma i * p.s * p.d i) =
          1 / 16 * (p.sigma i ^ 2) * p.s ^ 2 * p.d i ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this, hsi]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.s]
    · 
      have hsi := p.sigma_sq i
      have hdi := p.d_sq_le i
      have h_sqrt : Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) = Real.sqrt (15 / 16) := by norm_num
      have h_sq : Real.sqrt (15 / 16) ^ 2 = 15 / 16 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt]; norm_num
      have : (1 : ℝ) / 4 * p.sigma i * Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) * p.d i *
          (1 / 4 * p.sigma i * Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) * p.d i) =
          1 / 16 * (p.sigma i ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (1 - 1 / 16) ^ 2) * p.d i ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this, hsi, h_sqrt, h_sq]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.d i)]
  
  
  have h_sum : ∑ i : Fin p.m, p.z i * p.z i ≤
      15 / 256 * p.alpha ^ 2 + (↑p.m - 1) * (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
    
    let last : Fin p.m := ⟨p.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos p.hm⟩
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ last)]
    apply add_le_add
    · 
      have hlast : ¬ (last.val < p.m - 1) := by simp [last]
      have := hz_entry last
      rw [if_neg hlast] at this
      exact this
    · 
      have h_card : (Finset.univ.erase last).card = p.m - 1 := by
        rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ last)]; simp [Fintype.card_fin]
      calc ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase last, p.z j * p.z j
          ≤ (Finset.univ.erase last).card • (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul
            intro j hj
            have hj_ne : j ≠ last := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj
            have hj_lt : j.val < p.m - 1 := by
              have hj_lt_m := j.isLt
              have : j.val ≠ p.m - 1 := by
                intro heq
                exact hj_ne (Fin.ext heq)
              omega
            have := hz_entry j
            rw [if_pos hj_lt] at this
            exact this
        _ = ↑(Finset.univ.erase last).card * (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := nsmul_eq_mul _ _
        _ = (↑p.m - 1) * (p.s ^ 2 / 16 * p.alpha ^ 2) := by
            rw [h_card, Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ p.m from p.hm)]; simp
  
  have h_s_bound : (↑p.m - 1) * p.s ^ 2 / 8 ≤ p.eta / 4 := by linarith [p.m_sub_one_mul_s_sq_le]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.s, sq_nonneg p.alpha]

name: M_rem_trace_ge
statement:
theorem M_rem_trace_ge :
    p.M_rem.trace ≥ ↑p.m - ↑p.m * p.alpha ^ 2 * (1 + p.eta / 2) -
    p.alpha ^ 2 * (p.eta / 4 + 15 / 128)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : p.M_rem.trace = (1 : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ).trace -
      (p.R_beta * p.R_beta.transpose).trace -
      kappa_z * (vecMulVec p.z p.z).trace := by
    unfold M_rem
    simp only [Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have h2 : (1 : Matrix (Fin p.m) (Fin p.m) ℝ).trace = ↑p.m := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_one, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h3 : (vecMulVec p.z p.z).trace = p.z ⬝ᵥ p.z := Matrix.trace_vecMulVec p.z p.z
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  linarith [p.R_beta_trace_le, p.kz_z_norm_sq_le]

name: eigenvalue_le_one
statement:
theorem eigenvalue_le_one
    (gp : GlobalParams)
    (h_sym : gp.M_rem.IsHermitian) :
    ∀ h : Fin gp.m, h_sym.eigenvalues h ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h_psd : ((1 : Matrix _ _ ℝ) - gp.M_rem).PosSemidef := by
    have h_eq : (1 : Matrix _ _ ℝ) - gp.M_rem =
        gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose +
        GlobalParams.kappa_z • Matrix.vecMulVec gp.z gp.z := by
      simp only [GlobalParams.M_rem]; ext i j
      simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
        Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [h_eq]
    have hRRT : (gp.R_beta * gp.R_beta.transpose).PosSemidef := by
      rw [show gp.R_beta.transpose = gp.R_beta.conjTranspose from by ext i j; simp]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose gp.R_beta
    exact hRRT.add (by
      apply Matrix.PosSemidef.smul _ (by unfold GlobalParams.kappa_z; norm_num)
      rw [show Matrix.vecMulVec gp.z gp.z = Matrix.vecMulVec gp.z (star gp.z)
            from by ext i; simp [star_trivial]]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star gp.z)
  set v := (h_sym.eigenvectorBasis h).ofLp with hv_def
  have h_quad : 0 ≤ star v ⬝ᵥ ((1 - gp.M_rem) *ᵥ v) :=
    h_psd.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg v
  rw [show star v = v from funext (fun i => star_trivial (r := v i)),
      show (1 - gp.M_rem) *ᵥ v = v - gp.M_rem *ᵥ v from by
        simp [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec],
      dotProduct_sub, h_sym.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis h, dotProduct_smul] at h_quad
  have h_vv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    have h_norm := EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq (h_sym.eigenvectorBasis h)
    rw [h_sym.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 h, one_pow] at h_norm
    simp only [dotProduct, sq] at h_norm ⊢; linarith
  rw [h_vv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h_quad; linarith

name: N_split_pos
statement: private lemma N_split_pos (gp : GlobalParams) : 0 < N_split gp
proof:
:= by
  unfold N_split; omega

name: dm_sq_pos
statement: private lemma dm_sq_pos (gp : GlobalParams) : gp.d_m ^ 2 > 0
proof:
:=
  sq_pos_of_pos (gp.d_pos' ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩)

name: one_div_N_split_lt
statement:
private lemma one_div_N_split_lt (gp : GlobalParams) :
    (1 : ℝ) / ↑(N_split gp) < gp.d_m ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hx := dm_sq_pos gp
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ↑(N_split gp) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (N_split_pos gp)
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
  have hceil : (1 / (gp.d_m ^ 2) : ℝ) ≤ ↑(Nat.ceil (1 / (gp.d_m ^ 2))) :=
    Nat.le_ceil _
  have hstep : (↑(Nat.ceil (1 / (gp.d_m ^ 2))) : ℝ) < ↑(N_split gp) := by
    unfold N_split; push_cast; linarith
  calc gp.d_m ^ 2 * ↑(N_split gp)
      > gp.d_m ^ 2 * (1 / (gp.d_m ^ 2)) := by nlinarith
    _ = 1 := mul_one_div_cancel (ne_of_gt hx)

name: divNat_finProdFinEquiv
statement:
private lemma divNat_finProdFinEquiv {m N : ℕ} (hN : N > 0) (ν : Fin m) (k : Fin N) :
    (finProdFinEquiv (ν, k)).divNat = ν
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [Fin.coe_divNat, finProdFinEquiv_apply_val]
  rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ hN, Nat.div_eq_of_lt k.isLt, zero_add]

name: ColIndex.sum_eq
statement:
lemma ColIndex.sum_eq {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] {m H J : ℕ}
    (f : ColIndex m H J → α) :
    ∑ c, f c = ∑ q, f (.selected q) + f .finalSelected
      + ∑ i, f (.cross i) + ∑ h, f (.frame h)
      + ∑ j, f (.residual j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_equiv (colIndexEquiv m H J) f
    (fun s => f ((colIndexEquiv m H J).symm s))
    (fun c => by simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply])]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, colIndexEquiv, Equiv.symm]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
  abel

name: colIndex_card
statement:
lemma colIndex_card (m H J : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (ColIndex m H J) = m + 1 + 2 + H + J
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (colIndexEquiv m H J)]
  simp [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]; omega

name: coherence_bound
statement:
theorem coherence_bound
    {n₀ k : ℕ}
    (Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hQTQ : Q₀.transpose * Q₀ = 1)
    (H_star : ℝ)
    (h_ratio : (↑n₀ : ℝ) / (↑k : ℝ) < H_star)
    (hk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (↑k : ℝ))
    [Nonempty (Fin n₀)] :
    mu Q₀ < H_star
proof:
:= by
  have hP_proj : Q₀ * Q₀.transpose * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) = Q₀ * Q₀.transpose := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q₀.transpose Q₀ Q₀.transpose]
    rw [hQTQ, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hP_symm_entry : ∀ a b : Fin n₀, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) a b = (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) b a := by
    intro a b
    have hP_symm : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose).transpose = Q₀ * Q₀.transpose := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    have := congr_fun (congr_fun hP_symm b) a
    rwa [Matrix.transpose_apply] at this
  have h_row_bound : ∀ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin k, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    have hP_ii : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i = ∑ j, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 := by
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, sq]
    have hPP_diag : ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 = (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i := by
      have h1 : ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose)) i i =
          ∑ k, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) k i := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
      have h2 : ∑ k, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) k i =
          ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 := by
        congr 1; ext k; rw [sq, hP_symm_entry k i]
      linarith [congr_fun (congr_fun hP_proj i) i, h1, h2]
    have hPii_sq_le : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [← hP_ii]
    nlinarith [hPP_diag, hPii_sq_le, sq_nonneg ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i - 1)]
  have h_sup_le : ⨆ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin k, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 ≤ 1 :=
    ciSup_le h_row_bound
  have h_mu_le : mu Q₀ ≤ (↑n₀ : ℝ) / (↑k : ℝ) := by
    unfold mu
    calc (↑n₀ / ↑k : ℝ) * (⨆ i, ∑ j, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2)
        ≤ (↑n₀ / ↑k : ℝ) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sup_le (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hk_pos))
      _ = ↑n₀ / ↑k := mul_one _
  linarith

name: coherence_bound_product
statement:
theorem coherence_bound_product
    {n₀ k : ℕ}
    (Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (_hQTQ : Q₀.transpose * Q₀ = 1)
    (H_star : ℝ)
    (h_product : (↑n₀ : ℝ) / (↑k : ℝ) * (⨆ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin k, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2) < H_star)
    (_hk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (↑k : ℝ))
    [Nonempty (Fin n₀)] :
    mu Q₀ < H_star
proof:
:= by
  unfold mu; exact h_product

name: tendsto_exp_sqrt_div_rpow_nat
statement:
lemma tendsto_exp_sqrt_div_rpow_nat (c : ℝ) (hc : c > 0) (P : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (c * Real.sqrt n) / (n : ℝ) ^ P)
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
proof:
:= by
  have h_sqrt_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have h_exp_div := tendsto_exp_mul_div_rpow_atTop (2 * P) c hc
  have h_comp := h_exp_div.comp h_sqrt_tendsto
  refine h_comp.congr (fun n => ?_)
  simp only [Function.comp]
  congr 1
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) * P = 2 * P from rfl,
      Real.rpow_mul (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
      Real.rpow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]

name: bsns_threshold_exists
statement:
theorem bsns_threshold_exists (eta : ℝ) (heta : eta > 0)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : B > 0) (e : ℝ) (_he : e ≥ 0) :
    ∃ M_bsns : ℕ, M_bsns ≥ 2 ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ M_bsns →
      let eps
proof:
:= Real.exp (-eta / (↑m + 1))
      let s_val := Real.sqrt (1 - eps ^ 2)
      let roe := (1 + s_val / 2) / eps
      let alpha := 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)
      s_val ^ 2 * 15 * roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) >
        64 * alpha ^ 2 * eps ^ 2 *
        ((B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2))) := by
  set c_val := Real.sqrt (eta / 2) / 4 with hc_def
  have hc_pos : c_val > 0 := by positivity
  have h_tendsto := tendsto_exp_sqrt_div_rpow_nat c_val hc_pos (2 * e + 5)
  rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop] at h_tendsto
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_tendsto (128 * B ^ 2 / (eta * 15) + 1)
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * eta)
  refine ⟨max (max N₀ M₀) 4, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro m hm; simp only
  
  have hm_N : N₀ ≤ m := by omega
  have hm4 : m ≥ 4 := by omega
  have hm_cast : (↑m : ℝ) ≥ 4 := by exact_mod_cast hm4
  have hm1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (↑m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  set eps := Real.exp (-eta / (↑m + 1))
  set s := Real.sqrt (1 - eps ^ 2)
  set roe := (1 + s / 2) / eps
  
  have heps_pos : eps > 0 := Real.exp_pos _
  have hneg : -eta / (↑m + 1) < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hm1_pos
  have heps_lt1 : eps < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr hneg
  have h1_eps_sq : 1 - eps ^ 2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg eps]
  
  have hs_pos : s > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos h1_eps_sq
  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = 1 - eps ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt h1_eps_sq)
  have hs_le1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    calc s = Real.sqrt (1 - eps ^ 2) := rfl
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg eps])
      _ = 1 := Real.sqrt_one
  
  have heta_small : eta / (↑m + 1) < 1 / 2 := by
    have hM_le : (↑M₀ : ℝ) ≤ ↑m := Nat.cast_le.mpr (by omega)
    have : eta * 2 < (↑m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hm1_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
    linarith
  have heta_div_pos : eta / (↑m + 1) > 0 := div_pos heta hm1_pos
  have h_inv : eps ≤ 1 / (1 + eta / (↑m + 1)) := by
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (eta / (↑m + 1))
    have heps_eq : eps = (Real.exp (eta / (↑m + 1)))⁻¹ := by
      simp only [eps, neg_div, Real.exp_neg]
    rw [heps_eq, one_div]
    exact inv_anti₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hs_sq_ge : s ^ 2 ≥ eta / (↑m + 1) := by
    rw [hs_sq]
    have h_eps_sq_le : eps ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (1 + eta / (↑m + 1))) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt heps_pos) h_inv 2
    have h_ub : (1 / (1 + eta / (↑m + 1))) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - eta / (↑m + 1) := by
      rw [div_pow, one_pow]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith : 1 + eta / (↑m + 1) > 0))]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (eta / (↑m + 1))]
    linarith
  
  have hroe_ge_exp : roe ≥ Real.exp (s / 4) := by
    have : Real.exp (s / 4) ≤ 1 + s / 2 := by
      have := Real.exp_bound_div_one_sub_of_interval (show (0:ℝ) ≤ s / 4 by linarith)
        (show s / 4 < 1 by linarith)
      have : 1 / (1 - s / 4) ≤ 1 + s / 2 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]
      linarith
    change (1 + s / 2) / eps ≥ _
    rw [ge_iff_le, le_div_iff₀ heps_pos]
    nlinarith [le_of_lt heps_lt1]
  
  have hroe_pos : roe > 0 := div_pos (by linarith) heps_pos
  have hm_sub2 : (↑m : ℝ) - 2 ≥ 0 := by linarith
  have h_exp_eq : Real.exp (s / 4) ^ (2 * (m - 2)) = Real.exp (s * (↑m - 2) / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_comm]
    congr 1
    have : (↑(2 * (m - 2)) : ℝ) = 2 * ((↑m : ℝ) - 2) := by
      rw [show (2 * (m - 2) : ℕ) = 2 * m - 4 from by omega,
        Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 4 ≤ 2 * m)]; push_cast; ring
    rw [this]; ring
  have hs_growth : s * (↑m - 2) / 2 ≥ c_val * Real.sqrt (↑m + 1) := by
    apply le_of_sq_le_sq _ (by positivity)
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : (↑m : ℝ) + 1 ≥ 0)]
    have hc_sq : c_val ^ 2 = eta / 2 / 16 := by
      rw [hc_def, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : eta / 2 ≥ 0)]; ring
    rw [hc_sq]
    have h_key : eta / (↑m + 1) * ((↑m : ℝ) - 2) ^ 2 ≥ eta * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) / 8 := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ge_iff_le, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 8) hm1_pos]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((↑m : ℝ) - 4)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg s, sq_nonneg ((↑m : ℝ) - 2),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_sq_ge (sq_nonneg ((↑m : ℝ) - 2))]
  have hroe_exp : roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) ≥ Real.exp (c_val * Real.sqrt (↑m + 1)) := by
    calc roe ^ (2 * (m - 2))
        ≥ Real.exp (s / 4) ^ (2 * (m - 2)) :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) hroe_ge_exp _
      _ = Real.exp (s * (↑m - 2) / 2) := h_exp_eq
      _ ≥ Real.exp (c_val * Real.sqrt (↑m + 1)) := Real.exp_le_exp_of_le hs_growth
  
  have hm1_N : N₀ ≤ m + 1 := by omega
  have hN := hN₀ (m + 1) hm1_N
  have hcast : (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) = (↑m : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hcast] at hN
  have hm1_rpow_pos : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e + 5) > 0 :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hm1_pos _
  have hexp_ge : Real.exp (c_val * Real.sqrt (↑m + 1)) ≥
      (128 * B ^ 2 / (eta * 15) + 1) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 5) := by
    rw [ge_iff_le]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hm1_rpow_pos).mp hN
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  
  have h_roe_lower : roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) ≥
      (128 * B ^ 2 / (eta * 15) + 1) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 5) :=
    le_trans hexp_ge hroe_exp
  
  
  
  

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  
  

  
  
  

  
  
  
  
  

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hrpow_2e_pos : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e) > 0 :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hm1_pos _
  
  have hrpow_split : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e + 5) = (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e + 4) * (↑m + 1) := by
    rw [show (2 * e + 5 : ℝ) = (2 * e + 4) + 1 from by ring,
        Real.rpow_add (by linarith : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) > 0), Real.rpow_one]
  
  have hrpow_mono : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e + 4) ≥ (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e + 1) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith : 1 ≤ (↑m + 1 : ℝ)) (by linarith)
  
  
  
  
  
  have h_lhs_simplified : eta / (↑m + 1) * 15 * ((128 * B ^ 2 / (eta * 15) + 1) *
      (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 5)) = (128 * B ^ 2 + 15 * eta) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) := by
    rw [hrpow_split]
    have heta15 : eta * 15 > 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  have h_lhs_ge : s ^ 2 * 15 * roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) ≥
      (128 * B ^ 2 + 15 * eta) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) := by
    have h1 : s ^ 2 ≥ eta / (↑m + 1) := hs_sq_ge
    have h2 : roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) ≥
        (128 * B ^ 2 / (eta * 15) + 1) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 5) := h_roe_lower
    have h_target_pos : (128 * B ^ 2 / (eta * 15) + 1) *
        (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 5) > 0 := by positivity
    calc s ^ 2 * 15 * roe ^ (2 * (m - 2))
        ≥ eta / (↑m + 1) * 15 * roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) := by
          nlinarith [le_of_lt h_target_pos, le_of_lt hroe_pos,
            pow_nonneg (le_of_lt hroe_pos) (2 * (m - 2))]
      _ ≥ eta / (↑m + 1) * 15 * ((128 * B ^ 2 / (eta * 15) + 1) *
          (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 5)) := by
          nlinarith [div_pos heta hm1_pos]
      _ = (128 * B ^ 2 + 15 * eta) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) := h_lhs_simplified
  
  
  
  have h_Bme_sq : (B * (↑m + 1) ^ e) ^ 2 = B ^ 2 * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e) := by
    rw [mul_pow, sq ((↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ e),
        ← Real.rpow_add (by linarith : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) > 0), show e + e = 2 * e from by ring]
  
  
  
  
  

  
  have hrpow_2e_times_m1 : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e) * (↑m + 1) = (↑m + 1 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e + 1) := by
    rw [show (2 * e + 1 : ℝ) = 2 * e + 1 from rfl,
        Real.rpow_add (by linarith : (↑m + 1 : ℝ) > 0), Real.rpow_one]
  have h_rhs_le : 64 * (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 * eps ^ 2 *
      ((B * (↑m + 1) ^ e) ^ 2 * (2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2))) ≤
      128 * B ^ 2 * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 1) := by
    rw [h_Bme_sq, ← hrpow_2e_times_m1]
    suffices h : 64 * (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 * eps ^ 2 * (2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2))
        ≤ 128 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) by
      nlinarith [hrpow_2e_pos, sq_nonneg B, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h
        (by positivity : B ^ 2 * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e) ≥ 0)]
    have : 64 * (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 * eps ^ 2 * (2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2))
        = 128 * eps ^ 2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) := by field_simp; ring
    rw [this, div_le_iff₀ hm1_pos]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg eps, sq_nonneg ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)]
  
  calc s ^ 2 * 15 * roe ^ (2 * (m - 2))
      ≥ (128 * B ^ 2 + 15 * eta) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) := h_lhs_ge
    _ > 128 * B ^ 2 * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 1) := by
        have h1 : (128 * B ^ 2 + 15 * eta) * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) ≥
            128 * B ^ 2 * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) := by nlinarith
        have h2 : 128 * B ^ 2 * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) ≥
            128 * B ^ 2 * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 1) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_mono (by positivity)
        
        have h3 : 15 * eta * (↑m + 1) ^ (2 * e + 4) > 0 := by positivity
        linarith
    _ ≥ 64 * (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 * eps ^ 2 *
        ((B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 * (2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2))) := by
        rw [hcast]; exact h_rhs_le

name: selectedBlock_mul_specialVector
statement:
theorem selectedBlock_mul_specialVector
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta) :
    selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv =
      fun i => match i with
        | Sum.inl _ => 0
        | Sum.inr _ => eta_p
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  have hinst : @Finset.univ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) _
              = @Finset.univ _ (instFintypeSum (Fin m) (Fin 1)) := by
    congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  funext i
  rcases i with j | j
  · 
    change (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv) (Sum.inl j) = 0
    unfold selectedBlock
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hinst]
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂, backSubstVector]
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Fin.sum_univ_one, mul_one]
    have : (∑ a₁, R_beta j a₁ * (R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z) a₁) = z j :=
      show (R_beta *ᵥ (R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z)) j = z j by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    linarith
  · 
    change (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv) (Sum.inr j) = eta_p
    unfold selectedBlock
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hinst]
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, backSubstVector]

name: R_plus_mul_v_norm_sq
statement:
theorem R_plus_mul_v_norm_sq
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
      (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p *ᵥ backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv)‖ ^ 2 = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [selectedBlock_mul_specialVector R_beta z eta_p h_inv]
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  
  have hofLp : ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
                  (fun i : Fin m ⊕ Fin 1 => match i with
                    | Sum.inl _ => (0:ℝ)
                    | Sum.inr _ => eta_p)).ofLp =
                fun i : Fin m ⊕ Fin 1 => match i with
                  | Sum.inl _ => (0:ℝ)
                  | Sum.inr _ => eta_p := rfl
  rw [hofLp]
  
  have hinst : @Finset.univ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) _
              = @Finset.univ _ (instFintypeSum (Fin m) (Fin 1)) := by
    congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hinst, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp [hr, sq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: specialVector_norm_sq
statement:
theorem specialVector_norm_sq
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta) :
    ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
      (backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv)‖ ^ 2 =
    1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv
proof:
:= by
  unfold backSubstNormSq
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  have hofLp_v : ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm
                    (backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv)).ofLp =
                  backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv := rfl
  have hofLp_u : ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z)).ofLp =
                  R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ z := rfl
  rw [hofLp_v, hofLp_u]
  
  
  have hinst : @Finset.univ (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) _
              = @Finset.univ _ (instFintypeSum (Fin m) (Fin 1)) := by
    congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hinst, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [backSubstVector, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, neg_sq]
  rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  simp

name: singular_value_bound
statement:
theorem singular_value_bound
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (hr_pos : r > 0)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    
    
    
    (h_inv_block : Invertible (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)) :
    ‖(selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ ^ 2 ≥
    (1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv) / r
proof:
:= by
  set R_plus := selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p with hR_plus_def
  set v := backSubstVector R_beta z h_inv with hv_def
  
  have h_inv_cancel : R_plus⁻¹ *ᵥ (R_plus *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.inv_mul_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  
  
  
  
  have h_op :
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus⁻¹ *ᵥ (R_plus *ᵥ v))‖
        ≤ ‖R_plus⁻¹‖ * ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus *ᵥ v)‖ :=
    Matrix.l2_opNorm_mulVec R_plus⁻¹
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus *ᵥ v))
  
  rw [h_inv_cancel] at h_op
  
  have h_v_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm v‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have h_op_sq :
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm v‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (‖R_plus⁻¹‖ * ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ).symm (R_plus *ᵥ v)‖) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ h_v_nonneg h_op 2
  rw [mul_pow] at h_op_sq
  
  
  
  rw [R_plus_mul_v_norm_sq R_beta z eta_p r hr h_inv,
      specialVector_norm_sq R_beta z h_inv] at h_op_sq
  
  
  rw [ge_iff_le, div_le_iff₀ hr_pos]
  exact h_op_sq

name: norm_transpose_eq_norm
statement:
theorem norm_transpose_eq_norm
    {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    ‖Aᵀ‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  exact Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose A

name: selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq
statement:
theorem selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (_ : Invertible R_beta) :
    ‖(selectedMatrix R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ = ‖(selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖
proof:
:= by
  change ‖((selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)ᵀ)⁻¹‖ = ‖(selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖
  rw [← Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
  exact norm_transpose_eq_norm _

name: inverse_norm_sq_lower_bound
statement:
theorem inverse_norm_sq_lower_bound
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (hr_pos : r > 0)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    (h_inv_block : Invertible (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)) :
    ‖(selectedMatrix R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ ^ 2 ≥
    (1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv) / r
proof:
:= by
  rw [selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq R_beta z eta_p h_inv]
  exact singular_value_bound R_beta z eta_p r hr hr_pos h_inv h_inv_block

name: lemma4_selected_block_pressure
statement:
theorem lemma4_selected_block_pressure
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (eta_p : ℝ)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r = eta_p ^ 2)
    (hr_pos : r > 0)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    (h_inv_block : Invertible (selectedBlock R_beta z eta_p)) :
    ‖(selectedMatrix R_beta z eta_p)⁻¹‖ ≥
    Real.sqrt (backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv / r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq R_beta z eta_p h_inv]
  have h_Z_nn : 0 ≤ backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv := by unfold backSubstNormSq; positivity
  have h_sq := inverse_norm_sq_lower_bound R_beta z eta_p r hr hr_pos h_inv h_inv_block
  rw [selectedMatrix_inv_norm_eq R_beta z eta_p h_inv] at h_sq
  rw [ge_iff_le, ← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  linarith [div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv ≤
    1 + backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv) hr_pos.le, h_sq]

name: backSubstNormSq_growth
statement:
theorem backSubstNormSq_growth
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k = m + 1)
    (gamma_0 eta : ℝ)
    (hgamma_0 : gamma_0 = 1 / 4)
    (heta_pos : eta > 0)
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    (h_bsns_lower : backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv > gamma_0 ^ 2 * (eta / ↑k)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ m_large : ℕ, m ≥ m_large →
      backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv ≥
      gamma_0 ^ 2 * (eta / k) * Real.exp (c * Real.sqrt (k : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  set L := backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv with hL_def
  set A := gamma_0 ^ 2 * (eta / ↑k) with hA_def
  have hk_pos : (k : ℝ) > 0 := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hsqrt_pos : Real.sqrt (↑k : ℝ) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos hk_pos
  have hA_pos : A > 0 := by rw [hA_def, hgamma_0]; positivity
  have hratio_pos : L / A > 0 := div_pos (by linarith) hA_pos
  have hratio_gt_one : L / A > 1 := by rwa [gt_iff_lt, lt_div_iff₀ hA_pos, one_mul]
  refine ⟨Real.log (L / A) / Real.sqrt (↑k : ℝ), div_pos (Real.log_pos hratio_gt_one) hsqrt_pos,
         fun m_large _ => ?_⟩
  show L ≥ A * Real.exp (Real.log (L / A) / Real.sqrt ↑k * Real.sqrt ↑k)
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hsqrt_pos), Real.exp_log hratio_pos,
      mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hA_pos)]

name: Z_beats_polynomial
statement:
theorem Z_beats_polynomial
    (k : ℕ) (_ : k = m + 1)
    (gamma_0 eta : ℝ)
    (_ : gamma_0 = 1 / 4)
    (_ : eta > 0)
    (R_beta : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (z : Fin m → ℝ)
    (h_inv : Invertible R_beta)
    (B : ℝ) (_ : B > 0)
    (e : ℝ) (_ : e ≥ 0) :
    ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k' ≥ k₀, k' = m + 1 →
      backSubstNormSq R_beta z h_inv > B * (k' : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨m + 2, fun k' hk' hk'_eq => absurd hk'_eq (by omega)⟩

name: unitary_norm_conj
statement:
private lemma unitary_norm_conj {k : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin k)] [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (U : unitaryGroup (Fin k) ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    ‖(Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) U) A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, star_eq_conjTranspose]
  have hUU : (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ = 1 := by
    have := U.2; rw [Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff] at this; rwa [star_eq_conjTranspose] at this
  have hUHU : (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ * U = 1 := by
    have hdet : IsUnit (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ).det :=
      IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ (by rw [← Matrix.det_mul, hUU, Matrix.det_one])
    rw [← Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hUU]; exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet
  have hU1 : ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)‖ = 1 := by
    have h := Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, hUU, Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] at h
    have h1 : ‖(1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM, map_one]; exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id
    rw [h1] at h; nlinarith [norm_nonneg (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)]
  have hUH1 : ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose]; exact hU1
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * A * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ‖
        ≤ ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ‖ :=
            le_trans (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = ‖A‖ := by rw [hU1, hUH1]; ring
  · have key : A = (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ *
        ((U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * A * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ) *
        (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) := by
      have : (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ *
          ((U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * A * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ) *
          (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) =
          ((U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ * U) * A *
          ((U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ * U) := by simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [this, hUHU, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    conv_lhs => rw [key]
    calc ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ *
          ((U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * A * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ) *
          (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)‖
        ≤ ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ‖ *
          ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * A * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ‖ *
          ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)‖ :=
            le_trans (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = ‖(U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * A * (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ‖ := by
            rw [hU1, hUH1]; ring

name: iSup_inv_eq_inv_iInf
statement:
private lemma iSup_inv_eq_inv_iInf {k : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin k)] (f : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, 0 < f i) : ⨆ i, (f i)⁻¹ = (⨅ i, f i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have bddB : BddBelow (Set.range f) := (Set.finite_range f).bddBelow
  have bddA : BddAbove (Set.range (fun i => (f i)⁻¹)) := (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
  obtain ⟨i₀, _, hi₀⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ f
    ⟨Classical.arbitrary _, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have heq : ⨅ i, f i = f i₀ :=
    le_antisymm (ciInf_le bddB i₀) (le_ciInf (fun i => hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ _)))
  have hfpos : 0 < ⨅ i, f i := heq ▸ hf i₀
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ciSup_le; intro i; exact inv_anti₀ hfpos (ciInf_le bddB i)
  · rw [heq]; exact le_ciSup bddA i₀

name: norm_inv_eq_inv_sqrt_min_eigenvalue
statement:
lemma norm_inv_eq_inv_sqrt_min_eigenvalue {k : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin k)] [Nonempty (Fin k)]
    (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) [Invertible M] :
    ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.toFun M⁻¹)‖ =
      1 / Real.sqrt (⨅ (i : Fin k),
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self M).eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hM : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_det_of_invertible M
  have hCLM : (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) M⁻¹ :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.inverse (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) M) := by
    symm; apply ContinuousLinearMap.inverse_eq
    · rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ← map_mul, mul_nonsing_inv M hM, map_one,
          ContinuousLinearMap.one_def]
    · rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def, ← map_mul, nonsing_inv_mul M hM, map_one,
          ContinuousLinearMap.one_def]
  rw [show Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.toFun M⁻¹ =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) M⁻¹ :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) from rfl,
    Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM]
  
  set hH := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self M
  have hMHM_pd : (Mᴴ * M).PosDef := by
    apply Matrix.PosDef.conjTranspose_mul_self; intro x y h
    have := congr_arg (M⁻¹.mulVec ·) h
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hM, Matrix.one_mulVec] at this
    exact this
  have hpos : ∀ i, 0 < hH.eigenvalues i :=
    (Matrix.IsHermitian.posDef_iff_eigenvalues_pos hH).mp hMHM_pd
  
  have hMHM_inv : (Mᴴ * M)⁻¹ = hH.cfc (·⁻¹) := by
    rw [Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc]; apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    calc Mᴴ * M * ((Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) hH.eigenvectorUnitary)
          (Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ (·⁻¹) ∘ hH.eigenvalues)))
        = ((Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) hH.eigenvectorUnitary)
            (Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hH.eigenvalues))) *
          ((Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) hH.eigenvectorUnitary)
            (Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ (·⁻¹) ∘ hH.eigenvalues))) := by
              rw [← hH.spectral_theorem]
      _ = (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) hH.eigenvectorUnitary)
            (Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hH.eigenvalues) *
             Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ (·⁻¹) ∘ hH.eigenvalues)) := by rw [← map_mul]
      _ = 1 := by
            rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]; simp only [Function.comp]
            have : (fun i => (RCLike.ofReal (hH.eigenvalues i) : ℝ) *
                RCLike.ofReal ((hH.eigenvalues i)⁻¹)) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
              ext i; rw [← RCLike.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (hpos i)),
                         RCLike.ofReal_one]
            rw [this, Matrix.diagonal_one, map_one]
  
  have hMHM_inv_norm : ‖(Mᴴ * M)⁻¹‖ = 1 / ⨅ i, hH.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hMHM_inv, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc, unitary_norm_conj, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
    simp only [Pi.norm_def, Finset.sup_univ_eq_ciSup, Function.comp]
    rw [show (⨆ b, ‖(RCLike.ofReal (hH.eigenvalues b)⁻¹ : ℝ)‖₊ : NNReal).toReal =
        ⨆ i, (hH.eigenvalues i)⁻¹ from by
      simp only [NNReal.coe_iSup]
      congr 1; funext i
      rw [show (RCLike.ofReal (hH.eigenvalues i)⁻¹ : ℝ) = (hH.eigenvalues i)⁻¹ from rfl,
          Real.nnnorm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (hpos i).le), NNReal.coe_mk]]
    rw [iSup_inv_eq_inv_iInf _ hpos, one_div]
  
  have hM_inv_sq : ‖M⁻¹‖ ^ 2 = ‖(Mᴴ * M)⁻¹‖ := by
    rw [← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose M⁻¹, sq,
        ← Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (M⁻¹)ᴴ,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
  
  have hpos_iInf : 0 < ⨅ i, hH.eigenvalues i := by
    obtain ⟨i₀, _, hi₀⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ hH.eigenvalues
      ⟨Classical.arbitrary _, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    rw [le_antisymm (ciInf_le (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow i₀)
        (le_ciInf (fun i => hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ _)))]
    exact hpos i₀
  rw [one_div, ← Real.sqrt_inv, ← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), hM_inv_sq, hMHM_inv_norm,
      one_div, Real.sqrt_inv]

name: toEuclideanCLM_ofLp'
statement:
private lemma toEuclideanCLM_ofLp' {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := n)) A v).ofLp = A *ᵥ v.ofLp
proof:
:= by
  show (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v).ofLp = _
  show ((toLpLin (R := ℝ) 2 2 A) v).ofLp = _
  rw [ofLp_toLpLin]; rfl

name: ofLp_injective'
statement:
private lemma ofLp_injective' (p : ENNReal) {V : Type*} {a b : WithLp p V}
    (h : a.ofLp = b.ofLp) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (WithLp.toLp p) h
  rwa [WithLp.toLp_ofLp, WithLp.toLp_ofLp] at this

name: clm_norm_submatrix_finSumFinEquiv
statement:
private lemma clm_norm_submatrix_finSumFinEquiv (m : ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ) :
    ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin (m + 1)))
      (M.submatrix (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm)
        (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm))‖ =
    ‖(Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin m ⊕ Fin 1)) M‖
proof:
:= by
  set e := finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)
  set f' := (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin (m + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ))
    (M.submatrix (⇑e.symm) (⇑e.symm))
  set f := (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (𝕜 := ℝ)) M
  set φ := LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ e.symm
  have key : f' = (φ.symm.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap).comp
      (f.comp (φ.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap)) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext; intro v
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap,
               LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry]
    show f' v = φ.symm (f (φ v))
    apply ofLp_injective' 2
    rw [toEuclideanCLM_ofLp' (M.submatrix (⇑e.symm) (⇑e.symm)) v]
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_symm, show e.symm.symm = e from e.symm_symm]
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply]
    ext i; simp only [Equiv.piCongrLeft'_apply]
    rw [toEuclideanCLM_ofLp' M (φ v)]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    have phi_comp : ∀ j', (φ v).ofLp j' = v.ofLp (e j') := by
      intro j'
      show (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ e.symm v).ofLp j' = _
      rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_apply]
      simp [Equiv.piCongrLeft'_apply]
    simp_rw [phi_comp, Matrix.submatrix, ← Equiv.sum_comp e.symm]
    simp [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [key, LinearIsometry.norm_toContinuousLinearMap_comp,
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_linearIsometryEquiv]

name: gamma_ge_of_inv_submatrix
statement:
lemma gamma_ge_of_inv_submatrix {m : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin m ⊕ Fin 1) ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hM : ‖M‖ ≥ C)
    {n₀ : ℕ} (Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
    (pivots₀ : Fin (m + 1) → Fin n₀)
    (hInv : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀))
    (h_inv_eq : (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ =
      M.submatrix (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm)
        (⇑(finSumFinEquiv (m := m) (n := 1)).symm)) :
    gamma Q₀ pivots₀ hInv ≥ C
proof:
:= by
  show ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.toFun (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹‖ ≥ C
  have h_rfl : (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.toFun (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin (m + 1)))
        (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀)⁻¹ := rfl
  rw [h_rfl, h_inv_eq, clm_norm_submatrix_finSumFinEquiv]
  rwa [Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM]

name: pivotPrefix_mem_of_bound
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => simp [pivotPrefix] at hx
  | succ s ih =>
    simp only [pivotPrefix] at hx
    split_ifs at hx with h
    · rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_lt_k, rfl⟩ := ih (by omega) hx
        exact ⟨j, by omega, hj_lt_k, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨s, by omega, h, by rw [hx]⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_lt_k, rfl⟩ := ih (by omega) hx
      exact ⟨j, by omega, hj_lt_k, rfl⟩

name: pivotPrefix_pivot_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => omega
  | succ s ih =>
    simp only [pivotPrefix]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [List.mem_append]; by_cases hj_s' : j < s
      · exact Or.inl (ih hj_s')
      · have hjs : j = s := by omega
        subst hjs; exact Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
    · exact ih (by omega)

name: norm_sq_eq_last_sq
statement:
private lemma norm_sq_eq_last_sq {m : ℕ}
    (v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    (hw_head : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), i.val < m → w i = v i)
    (hw_tail : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), i.val ≥ m → w i = 0) :
    ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 = (v (Fin.last m)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h_expand : ‖v - w‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), ((v - w) i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]; congr 1; ext i; simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [h_expand]
  have h_zero : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), i ≠ Fin.last m → ((v - w) i) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have him : i.val < m := by have := i.isLt; simp [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.last] at hi; omega
    show (v i - w i) ^ 2 = 0
    rw [hw_head i him, sub_self]; ring
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last m) (fun b _ hb => h_zero b hb) (by simp)]
  show (v (Fin.last m) - w (Fin.last m)) ^ 2 = _
  rw [hw_tail (Fin.last m) (by simp [Fin.last])]; ring
