name: GlobalParams.epsilon_pos
statement: private lemma GlobalParams.epsilon_pos (gp : GlobalParams) : (0 : ℝ) < gp.epsilon
proof:
:=
  Real.exp_pos _

name: GlobalParams.epsilon_lt_one
statement: private lemma GlobalParams.epsilon_lt_one (gp : GlobalParams) : gp.epsilon < 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GlobalParams.epsilon]
  calc Real.exp _ < Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_strictMono (by
        apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
        · linarith [gp.heta_pos]
        · positivity)
    _ = 1 := Real.exp_zero

name: GlobalParams.epsilon_le_one
statement: private lemma GlobalParams.epsilon_le_one (gp : GlobalParams) : gp.epsilon ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  le_of_lt gp.epsilon_lt_one

name: geom_telescope
statement:
private lemma geom_telescope (e : ℝ) (t n : ℕ) :
    e ^ (2 * t + 2 * n) + (1 - e ^ 2) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, e ^ (2 * t + 2 * j) = e ^ (2 * t)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h_key : e ^ (2 * t + 2 * (n + 1)) + (1 - e ^ 2) * e ^ (2 * t + 2 * n) =
        e ^ (2 * t + 2 * n) := by
      rw [show 2 * t + 2 * (n + 1) = (2 * t + 2 * n) + 2 from by omega, pow_add]; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have : (1 - e ^ 2) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, e ^ (2 * t + 2 * j) + e ^ (2 * t + 2 * n)) =
        (1 - e ^ 2) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, e ^ (2 * t + 2 * j) +
        (1 - e ^ 2) * e ^ (2 * t + 2 * n) := by ring
    rw [this]; linarith

name: prefixSpan_contains_head
statement:
private lemma prefixSpan_contains_head
    (gp : GlobalParams) (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp)
    (t : Fin (gp.m + 1)) (ht : t.val ≤ gp.m) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
      if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
    let S_t := pivotPrefix pivots₀ t.val
    ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (gp.m + 1))),
      (∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), i.val ≥ t.val → v i = 0) →
      v ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ pivots₀ S_t v hv_supp
  
  have h_selected_is_pivot : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hrm : r < gp.m),
      eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, hrm⟩) = pivots₀ ⟨r, by omega⟩ := by
    intro r hrm; show eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, hrm⟩) =
      (if h : r < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected)
    rw [dif_pos hrm]
  
  have h_col_in_span : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hjt : j < t.val) (hjm : j < gp.m),
      colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩))) ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t := by
    intro j hjt hjm
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩), ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [h_selected_is_pivot j hjm]
    exact pivotPrefix_pivot_mem pivots₀ t.val j hjt (by omega)
  
  suffices key : ∀ t' : ℕ, t' ≤ t.val →
      ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (gp.m + 1)),
      (∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), i.val ≥ t' → w i = 0) →
      w ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t from
    key t.val le_rfl v hv_supp
  intro t'
  induction t' with
  | zero =>
    intro _ w hw
    have hweq : w = 0 := by ext i; exact hw i (Nat.zero_le _)
    rw [hweq]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ s ih =>
    intro hs w hw
    have hsm : s < gp.m := by omega
    have h_col_s := h_col_in_span s (by omega) hsm
    have h_col_s_entry : ∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)),
        (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨s, hsm⟩)))) i =
        if h : i.val < gp.m then gp.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h) ⟨s, hsm⟩ else 0 := by
      intro i
      simp only [colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
      show (A gp decomp resP) i (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨s, hsm⟩))) = _
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
    have h_diag : (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨s, hsm⟩))))
        ⟨s, by omega⟩ = gp.d ⟨s, hsm⟩ := by
      rw [h_col_s_entry]; rw [dif_pos hsm]
      simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
      have h_castLT : Fin.castLT (⟨s, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) hsm = ⟨s, hsm⟩ := by
        ext; simp [Fin.castLT]
      rw [h_castLT, if_pos rfl]
    have h_zero_above : ∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)), i.val > s →
        (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨s, hsm⟩)))) i = 0 := by
      intro i hi; rw [h_col_s_entry]
      by_cases him : i.val < gp.m
      · rw [dif_pos him]; simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
        have h_ne : Fin.castLT i him ≠ ⟨s, hsm⟩ := by
          intro h; have := congr_arg Fin.val h; simp [Fin.castLT] at this; omega
        rw [if_neg h_ne]
        have h_not_lt : ¬((Fin.castLT i him).val < (⟨s, hsm⟩ : Fin gp.m).val) := by
          simp [Fin.castLT]; omega
        rw [if_neg h_not_lt]
      · rw [dif_neg him]
    have h_d_pos : gp.d ⟨s, hsm⟩ > 0 := by
      simp only [GlobalParams.d]; exact mul_pos gp.halpha (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)
    set col_s := colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨s, hsm⟩)))
    set c := w ⟨s, by omega⟩ / gp.d ⟨s, hsm⟩
    have hw'_supp : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), i.val ≥ s → (w - c • col_s) i = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      show w i - c * col_s i = 0
      by_cases his : i.val = s
      · have h_i_eq : i = ⟨s, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext his
        rw [h_i_eq, h_diag]
        show w ⟨s, by omega⟩ - w ⟨s, by omega⟩ / gp.d ⟨s, hsm⟩ * gp.d ⟨s, hsm⟩ = 0
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt h_d_pos)]; ring
      · rw [h_zero_above i (by omega), hw i (by omega)]; ring
    have h_mem := ih (by omega : s ≤ t.val) (w - c • col_s) hw'_supp
    have h_eq : w = (w - c • col_s) + c • col_s := (sub_add_cancel w (c • col_s)).symm
    rw [h_eq]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ h_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ c h_col_s)

name: inner_zero_of_support_disjoint_aux
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  by_cases him : i.val < m
  · rw [hw i him]; simp
  · rw [hv i him]; simp

name: prefixSpan_coord_zero
statement:
private lemma prefixSpan_coord_zero {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (S : List (Fin n)) (coord : Fin k)
    (hcoord : ∀ s ∈ S, (colToEuclidean (columnA Q s)) coord = 0) :
    ∀ v ∈ prefixSpan Q S, (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) coord = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  simp only [prefixSpan] at hv
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => x coord = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hv
  · intro x hx; obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hcoord s hs
  · show (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) coord = 0; simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy; show (x + y) coord = 0; simp [hx, hy]
  · intro c x _ hx; show (c • x) coord = 0; simp [hx]

name: residualScore_le_norm_sub_sq
statement:
private lemma residualScore_le_norm_sub_sq {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (S : List (Fin n)) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (hw : w ∈ prefixSpan Q S) :
    residualScore Q i S ≤ ‖colToEuclidean (columnA Q i) - w‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold residualScore
  set a_i := colToEuclidean (columnA Q i)
  set V := prefixSpan Q S
  by_cases hS : S = []
  · 
    simp only [orthogonalProjector, dif_pos hS, LinearMap.zero_apply, sub_zero]
    
    have hw_zero : w = 0 := by
      have : V = ⊥ := by
        simp only [V, prefixSpan, hS]
        convert Submodule.span_empty (R := ℝ) (M := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
        ext x; simp [Set.mem_empty_iff_false]
      rwa [this, Submodule.mem_bot] at hw
    rw [hw_zero, sub_zero]
  · 
    unfold orthogonalProjector
    rw [dif_neg hS]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]
    
    
    
    set p := (V.orthogonalProjection a_i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) with hp_def
    
    have hp_star : p = V.starProjection a_i := rfl
    
    have h_res_ortho : a_i - p ∈ Vᗮ := by
      rw [hp_star]; exact V.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal a_i
    
    have h_diff_mem : p - w ∈ V := V.sub_mem (by rw [hp_star]; exact V.starProjection_apply_mem a_i) hw
    
    have h_inner_zero : @inner ℝ _ _ (a_i - p) (p - w) = 0 :=
      Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal h_diff_mem h_res_ortho
    
    have h_decomp : a_i - w = (a_i - p) + (p - w) := by
      simp only [sub_add_sub_cancel]
    
    calc ‖a_i - p‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a_i - p‖ ^ 2 + ‖p - w‖ ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖a_i - w‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [h_decomp, sq, sq, sq,
              norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_of_inner_eq_zero _ _ h_inner_zero]

name: orthogonalProjector_of_mem_ortho
statement:
private lemma orthogonalProjector_of_mem_ortho {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (S : List (Fin n)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (hv : v ∈ (prefixSpan Q S)ᗮ) :
    orthogonalProjector Q S v = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold orthogonalProjector
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]
    change ((prefixSpan Q S).orthogonalProjection v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) = 0
    rw [Submodule.orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_orthogonalComplement_eq_zero hv,
        Submodule.coe_zero]

name: residualScore_ge_coord_sq
statement:
private lemma residualScore_ge_coord_sq {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (S : List (Fin n)) (coord : Fin k)
    (hcoord : ∀ s ∈ S, (colToEuclidean (columnA Q s)) coord = 0) :
    (columnA Q i coord) ^ 2 ≤ residualScore Q i S
proof:
:= by
  unfold residualScore
  set a_i := colToEuclidean (columnA Q i)
  set P_S := orthogonalProjector Q S
  set residual := a_i - P_S a_i
  
  have h_PS_coord : (P_S a_i) coord = 0 := by
    show (orthogonalProjector Q S a_i) coord = 0
    unfold orthogonalProjector
    split_ifs with hS
    · simp
    · simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply]
      exact prefixSpan_coord_zero Q S coord hcoord _ (Submodule.coe_mem _)
  
  have h_res_coord : residual coord = a_i coord := by
    show (a_i - P_S a_i) coord = a_i coord
    change a_i coord - (P_S a_i) coord = a_i coord
    rw [h_PS_coord, sub_zero]
  
  have h_sq_le_norm : (residual coord) ^ 2 ≤ ‖residual‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    have h_eq : ‖residual.ofLp coord‖ ^ 2 = (residual coord) ^ 2 := by
      change ‖residual coord‖ ^ 2 = _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [← h_eq]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => ‖residual.ofLp j‖ ^ 2)
      (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ coord)
  
  have ha_coord : a_i coord = columnA Q i coord := by
    simp [a_i, colToEuclidean, WithLp.equiv]
  rw [← ha_coord, ← h_res_coord]
  exact h_sq_le_norm

name: score_selected_lt_pivot
statement:
private lemma score_selected_lt_pivot
    (gp : GlobalParams) (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp)
    (t : Fin (gp.m + 1)) (q : Fin gp.m)
    (hq_gt_t : q.val > t.val) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
      if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
    let S_t := pivotPrefix pivots₀ t.val
    residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected q)) S_t <
      residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ pivots₀ S_t
  have ht : (t : ℕ) < gp.m := by omega
  
  have h_selected_is_pivot : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hrm : r < gp.m),
      eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, hrm⟩) = pivots₀ ⟨r, by omega⟩ := by
    intro r hrm; show eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, hrm⟩) =
      (if h : r < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected)
    rw [dif_pos hrm]
  
  have h_piv_lb : (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
    have h_prefix_t_zero : ∀ s ∈ S_t,
        (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ s)) (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_k, rfl⟩ := pivotPrefix_mem_of_bound pivots₀ t.val (by omega) s hs
      have hjm : j < gp.m := by omega
      have hpj : pivots₀ ⟨j, hj_k⟩ = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩) :=
        (h_selected_is_pivot j hjm).symm
      rw [hpj]
      simp only [colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
      change (A gp decomp resP) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩
        (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩))) = 0
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
      rw [dif_pos ht]
      simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
      have h_castLT : Fin.castLT (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) ht = ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
        ext; simp [Fin.castLT]
      rw [h_castLT]
      have h_ne : (⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin gp.m) ≠ ⟨j, hjm⟩ := by
        intro heq; simp [Fin.ext_iff] at heq; omega
      have h_not_lt : ¬((⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin gp.m).val < (⟨j, hjm⟩ : Fin gp.m).val) := by
        simp; omega
      simp [h_ne, h_not_lt]
    have h_lb_t := residualScore_ge_coord_sq Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t
      (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) h_prefix_t_zero
    have h_piv_val : columnA Q₀ (pivots₀ t) (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) =
        gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
      simp only [columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.col_apply]
      show Q₀ (pivots₀ t) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩ = _
      simp only [Q₀]
      show (A gp decomp resP).transpose
        (eidx.symm (pivots₀ t)) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩ = _
      have hpiv : pivots₀ t = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, ht⟩) := dif_pos ht
      rw [hpiv, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
      rw [dif_pos ht]
      simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
      have h_castLT2 : Fin.castLT (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) ht = ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
        ext; simp [Fin.castLT]
      rw [h_castLT2]
      simp
    rw [h_piv_val] at h_lb_t
    exact h_lb_t
  
  have h_comp_ub : residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected q)) S_t <
      (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by
    
    
    set col_q := colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected q)))
    
    have h_col_q_entry : ∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)),
        col_q i = if h : i.val < gp.m then
          (gp.R_beta (Fin.castLT i h) q)
        else 0 := by
      intro i
      simp only [col_q, colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
      show (A gp decomp resP) i (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.selected q))) = _
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_w_exists : ∃ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (gp.m + 1)),
        w ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)), i.val < t.val → w i = col_q i) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)), i.val ≥ t.val → w i = 0) := by
      
      let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (gp.m + 1)) :=
        (WithLp.equiv 2 _).symm (fun i => if i.val < t.val then col_q i else 0)
      refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        apply prefixSpan_contains_head gp decomp resP t (by omega)
        intro i hi
        show (if i.val < t.val then col_q i else (0 : ℝ)) = 0
        simp [show ¬(i.val < t.val) from by omega]
      · intro i hi
        show (if i.val < t.val then col_q i else (0 : ℝ)) = col_q i
        simp [hi]
      · intro i hi
        show (if i.val < t.val then col_q i else (0 : ℝ)) = 0
        simp [show ¬(i.val < t.val) from by omega]
    obtain ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_head, hw_tail⟩ := h_w_exists
    
    have h_ub := residualScore_le_norm_sub_sq Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected q)) S_t w hw_mem
    
    have h_diff_sq : ‖col_q - w‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), (col_q i - w i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
      congr 1; ext i
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have h_diff_tail : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1),
        (col_q i - w i) ^ 2 = if i.val ≥ t.val then (col_q i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      intro i
      by_cases hit : i.val < t.val
      · rw [hw_head i hit, sub_self, sq, mul_zero, if_neg (by omega)]
      · rw [hw_tail i (by omega), sub_zero, if_pos (by omega)]
    
    have h_tail_sum_eq : ‖col_q - w‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1),
        if i.val ≥ t.val then (col_q i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      rw [h_diff_sq]; congr 1; ext i; exact h_diff_tail i
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_tail_lt_dt : ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1),
        (if i.val ≥ t.val then (col_q i) ^ 2 else 0) < (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by
      have h_eps_pos := gp.epsilon_pos
      have h_eps_lt_one := gp.epsilon_lt_one
      have h_alpha_pos : (0 : ℝ) < gp.alpha := gp.halpha
      have h_eps_le_one := gp.epsilon_le_one
      have h_sigma_sq : ∀ (j : Fin gp.m), gp.sigma j ^ 2 = 1 := by
        intro j; rcases gp.hsigma j with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
      
      have h_one_sub_eps_sq_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_s_sq : gp.s ^ 2 = 1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2 := by
        simp only [GlobalParams.s]; rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_one_sub_eps_sq_nn]
      
      
      
      
      
      have h_entry_bound : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), i.val ≥ t.val →
          (col_q i) ^ 2 ≤
            if i.val = q.val then gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val)
            else if i.val < q.val ∧ i.val < gp.m then
              (1 / 4) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * i.val)
            else 0 := by
        intro i hit
        rw [h_col_q_entry i]
        by_cases him : i.val < gp.m
        · rw [dif_pos him]
          simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
          have h_castLT_val : (Fin.castLT i him).val = i.val := by simp [Fin.castLT]
          by_cases hiq : Fin.castLT i him = q
          · 
            have hiv : i.val = q.val := by rw [← h_castLT_val, hiq]
            simp only [hiq, ↓reduceIte, if_pos hiv]
            show (gp.d q) ^ 2 ≤ gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val)
            simp only [GlobalParams.d, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
            exact le_of_eq (by congr 1; congr 1; omega)
          · simp only [hiq, ↓reduceIte]
            have hiv : i.val ≠ q.val := by
              intro h; apply hiq; ext; rwa [h_castLT_val]
            rw [if_neg hiv]
            by_cases hilt : (Fin.castLT i him).val < q.val
            · rw [if_pos hilt, if_pos ⟨by rwa [h_castLT_val] at hilt, him⟩]
              
              
              have hs1 := h_sigma_sq (Fin.castLT i him)
              have hs2 := h_sigma_sq q
              
              have h_expand : (-GlobalParams.beta * gp.sigma (Fin.castLT i him) *
                  gp.sigma q * gp.s * gp.d (Fin.castLT i him)) ^ 2 =
                  GlobalParams.beta ^ 2 * (gp.sigma (Fin.castLT i him)) ^ 2 *
                  (gp.sigma q) ^ 2 * gp.s ^ 2 * (gp.d (Fin.castLT i him)) ^ 2 := by ring
              rw [h_expand, hs1, hs2, h_s_sq, show GlobalParams.beta = (1 : ℝ) / 2 from rfl]
              simp only [GlobalParams.d, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
              rw [h_castLT_val, show i.val * 2 = 2 * i.val from by omega]
              
              
              exact le_of_eq (by ring)
            · rw [if_neg hilt]
              have hi_not_q : ¬(i.val < q.val ∧ i.val < gp.m) := by
                intro ⟨h1, _⟩; exact hilt (by rwa [h_castLT_val])
              rw [if_neg hi_not_q]; simp
        · rw [dif_neg him, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
          simp
      
      
      
      
      
      have hq_mem : (⟨q.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) ∈ Finset.univ := Finset.mem_univ _
      have hq_ge_t : (⟨q.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val ≥ t.val := by simp; omega
      
      have h_non_q_bound : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), i ≠ ⟨q.val, by omega⟩ →
          (if i.val ≥ t.val then (col_q i) ^ 2 else 0) ≤
            if t.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < q.val ∧ i.val < gp.m then
              (1 / 4) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * i.val)
            else 0 := by
        intro i hi
        have hiv : i.val ≠ q.val := fun h => hi (Fin.ext h)
        by_cases hit : i.val ≥ t.val
        · rw [if_pos hit]
          have := h_entry_bound i hit
          rw [if_neg hiv] at this
          by_cases hcond : i.val < q.val ∧ i.val < gp.m
          · rw [if_pos hcond] at this
            rw [if_pos ⟨hit, hcond.1, hcond.2⟩]
            exact this
          · rw [if_neg hcond] at this
            have hn : ¬(t.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < q.val ∧ i.val < gp.m) := by
              intro ⟨_, h1, h2⟩; exact hcond ⟨h1, h2⟩
            rw [if_neg hn]; exact this
        · rw [if_neg hit]; split_ifs <;> positivity
      
      have h_q_bound : (if (⟨q.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val ≥ t.val then
          (col_q ⟨q.val, by omega⟩) ^ 2 else 0) ≤
          gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) := by
        rw [if_pos hq_ge_t]
        have := h_entry_bound ⟨q.val, by omega⟩ hq_ge_t
        simp only [ite_true] at this; exact this
      
      
      
      
      
      
      have h_tail_le :
          ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), (if i.val ≥ t.val then (col_q i) ^ 2 else 0) ≤
          gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) +
          (1 / 4) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q.val - t.val), gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (t.val + j)) := by
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hq_mem]
        apply add_le_add h_q_bound
        apply le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => by
          have hi_ne : i ≠ ⟨q.val, by omega⟩ := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi
          exact h_non_q_bound i hi_ne))
        rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum]
        
        
        
        set S := (Finset.univ.erase ⟨q.val, by omega⟩).filter
          (fun i : Fin (gp.m + 1) => t.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < q.val ∧ i.val < gp.m)
        
        exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_nbij (fun (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)) => i.val - t.val)
          (fun i hi => by
            have him := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
            obtain ⟨ht_le, hi_lt_q, _⟩ := him
            exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.sub_lt_sub_right ht_le hi_lt_q))
          (fun i₁ hi₁ i₂ hi₂ heq => by
            have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hi₁)).2
            have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hi₂)).2
            obtain ⟨ht1, _, _⟩ := h1; obtain ⟨ht2, _, _⟩ := h2
            have heq' : i₁.val - t.val = i₂.val - t.val := heq
            exact Fin.ext (by omega))
          (fun j hj => by
            have hj_lt := Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hj)
            have hq_lt_m := q.isLt
            exact ⟨⟨t.val + j, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr
              ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨by intro h; simp [Fin.ext_iff] at h; omega, Finset.mem_univ _⟩,
               by simp; omega⟩), by simp⟩)
          (fun i hi => by
            have him := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
            obtain ⟨ht_le, _, _⟩ := him
            show (1 / 4) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * i.val) =
              (1 / 4) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (t.val + (i.val - t.val)))
            congr 1; congr 1; omega))
      
      
      have h_exp_eq : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (q.val - t.val),
          gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (t.val + j)) = gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * j) := by
        intro j _; congr 1; omega
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_exp_eq] at h_tail_le
      have h_tele := geom_telescope gp.epsilon t.val (q.val - t.val)
      rw [show 2 * t.val + 2 * (q.val - t.val) = 2 * q.val from by omega] at h_tele
      
      have h_geom_sum : (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q.val - t.val),
          gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * j) = gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val) - gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) := by
        linarith
      
      
      have h_rhs_eq : gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) +
          (1 / 4) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q.val - t.val), gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * j) =
          gp.alpha ^ 2 * ((3 / 4) * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) +
            (1 / 4) * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val)) := by
        nlinarith [h_geom_sum]
      
      have h_eps_pow_lt : gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) < gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val) := by
        exact pow_lt_pow_right_of_lt_one₀ h_eps_pos h_eps_lt_one (by omega)
      have h_alpha_sq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < gp.alpha ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h_dt_sq : (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val) := by
        simp only [GlobalParams.d, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        congr 1; congr 1; omega
      
      calc ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), (if ↑i ≥ ↑t then (col_q i) ^ 2 else 0)
          ≤ gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) +
            (1 / 4) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 *
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q.val - t.val), gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * j) := h_tail_le
        _ = gp.alpha ^ 2 * ((3 / 4) * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * q.val) +
            (1 / 4) * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val)) := h_rhs_eq
        _ < gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val) := by nlinarith
        _ = (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := h_dt_sq.symm
    linarith [h_ub, h_tail_sum_eq, h_tail_lt_dt]
  linarith

name: score_nonselected_lt_pivot
statement:
private lemma score_nonselected_lt_pivot
    (gp : GlobalParams) (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp)
    (t : Fin (gp.m + 1))
    (c : ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    (hc : ∀ q : Fin gp.m, c ≠ ColIndex.selected q)
    (hc_not_res : ∀ j : Fin resP.J, c ≠ ColIndex.residual j)
    (hc_final : c = ColIndex.finalSelected → t.val < gp.m) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
      if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
    let S_t := pivotPrefix pivots₀ t.val
    residualScore Q₀ (eidx c) S_t < residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ pivots₀ S_t
  
  have h_selected_is_pivot : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hrm : r < gp.m),
      eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, hrm⟩) = pivots₀ ⟨r, by omega⟩ := by
    intro r hrm; show eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, hrm⟩) =
      (if h : r < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨r, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected)
    rw [dif_pos hrm]
  
  have h_prefix_last_zero : ∀ s ∈ S_t,
      (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ s)) (Fin.last gp.m) = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_k, rfl⟩ := pivotPrefix_mem_of_bound pivots₀ t.val (by omega) s hs
    have hjm : j < gp.m := by omega
    have hpj : pivots₀ ⟨j, hj_k⟩ = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩) :=
      (h_selected_is_pivot j hjm).symm
    rw [hpj]
    simp only [colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
    change (A gp decomp resP) (Fin.last gp.m) (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩))) = 0
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
    have : ¬((Fin.last gp.m).val < gp.m) := by simp [Fin.last]
    rw [dif_neg this]
  
  have h_prefix_t_zero : ∀ (ht : t.val < gp.m), ∀ s ∈ S_t,
      (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ s)) (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = 0 := by
    intro ht s hs
    obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_k, rfl⟩ := pivotPrefix_mem_of_bound pivots₀ t.val (by omega) s hs
    have hjm : j < gp.m := by omega
    have hpj : pivots₀ ⟨j, hj_k⟩ = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩) :=
      (h_selected_is_pivot j hjm).symm
    rw [hpj]
    simp only [colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
    change (A gp decomp resP) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩
      (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩))) = 0
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
    rw [dif_pos ht]
    simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
    have h_castLT : Fin.castLT (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) ht = ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
      ext; simp [Fin.castLT]
    rw [h_castLT]
    have h_ne : (⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin gp.m) ≠ ⟨j, hjm⟩ := by
      intro heq; simp [Fin.ext_iff] at heq; omega
    have h_not_lt : ¬((⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin gp.m).val < (⟨j, hjm⟩ : Fin gp.m).val) := by
      simp; omega
    simp [h_ne, h_not_lt]
  
  have h_piv_lb_d : ∀ (ht : t.val < gp.m),
      (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
    intro ht
    have h_lb_t := residualScore_ge_coord_sq Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t
      (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) (h_prefix_t_zero ht)
    have h_piv_val : columnA Q₀ (pivots₀ t) (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) =
        gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
      simp only [columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.col_apply]
      show Q₀ (pivots₀ t) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩ = _
      simp only [Q₀]
      show (A gp decomp resP).transpose
        (eidx.symm (pivots₀ t)) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩ = _
      have hpiv : pivots₀ t = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, ht⟩) := dif_pos ht
      rw [hpiv, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
      rw [dif_pos ht]
      simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
      have h_castLT2 : Fin.castLT (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) ht = ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
        ext; simp [Fin.castLT]
      rw [h_castLT2]; simp
    rw [h_piv_val] at h_lb_t; exact h_lb_t
  
  have h_piv_lb_r : gp.r / 2 ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
    have h_lb := residualScore_ge_coord_sq Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t (Fin.last gp.m) h_prefix_last_zero
    by_cases ht : t.val < gp.m
    · calc gp.r / 2 ≤ (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by
            have h_eps_pos := gp.epsilon_pos
            have h_eps_le_one := gp.epsilon_le_one
            have h_dm_le : gp.d_m ≤ gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
              simp only [GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt gp.halpha)
              exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (le_of_lt h_eps_pos) h_eps_le_one (by omega)
            have h_r_le_dm : gp.r / 2 ≤ gp.d_m ^ 2 := by
              have : gp.r = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.d_m ^ 2 := rfl
              rw [this]; have := sq_nonneg gp.d_m; linarith
            have h_d_nonneg : 0 ≤ gp.d_m := by
              simp only [GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d]
              exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt gp.halpha) (pow_nonneg (le_of_lt h_eps_pos) _)
            calc gp.r / 2 ≤ gp.d_m ^ 2 := h_r_le_dm
              _ ≤ (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ h_d_nonneg h_dm_le 2
        _ ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := h_piv_lb_d ht
    · 
      have h_piv_val : columnA Q₀ (pivots₀ t) (Fin.last gp.m) = gp.eta_p := by
        simp only [columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.col_apply]
        show Q₀ (pivots₀ t) (Fin.last gp.m) = _
        simp only [Q₀]
        show (A gp decomp resP).transpose
          (eidx.symm (pivots₀ t)) (Fin.last gp.m) = _
        have hpiv : pivots₀ t = eidx ColIndex.finalSelected := dif_neg ht
        rw [hpiv, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_p, Fin.last]
      rw [h_piv_val] at h_lb
      calc gp.r / 2 ≤ gp.eta_p ^ 2 := by
            have h_eq : gp.eta_p ^ 2 = gp.r := by
              simp only [GlobalParams.eta_p, GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.tau_0]
              rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) / 16 ≥ 0)]
            rw [h_eq]; have : gp.r ≥ 0 := by show (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.d_m ^ 2 ≥ 0; positivity
            linarith
        _ ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := h_lb
  
  
  have h_zero_in_span : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (gp.m + 1))) ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t :=
    Submodule.zero_mem _
  have h_score_le_norm : residualScore Q₀ (eidx c) S_t ≤
      ‖colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx c))‖ ^ 2 := by
    have := residualScore_le_norm_sub_sq Q₀ (eidx c) S_t 0 h_zero_in_span
    simp only [sub_zero] at this; exact this
  
  rcases c with q | _ | ci | h_idx | j_res
  · 
    exact absurd rfl (hc q)
  · 
    have ht : t.val < gp.m := hc_final rfl
    
    set col_p := colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx ColIndex.finalSelected))
    let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (gp.m + 1)) :=
      (WithLp.equiv 2 _).symm (fun i => if i.val < t.val then col_p i else 0)
    have hw_mem : w ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t := by
      apply prefixSpan_contains_head gp decomp resP t (by omega)
      intro i hi; show (if i.val < t.val then col_p i else (0 : ℝ)) = 0
      simp [show ¬(i.val < t.val) from by omega]
    have h_ub := residualScore_le_norm_sub_sq Q₀ (eidx ColIndex.finalSelected) S_t w hw_mem
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    have h_tail_lt : residualScore Q₀ (eidx ColIndex.finalSelected) S_t <
        (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by
      
      have h_eps_pos := gp.epsilon_pos
      have h_eps_lt_one := gp.epsilon_lt_one
      have h_eps_le_one := gp.epsilon_le_one
      have h_sigma_sq : ∀ j : Fin gp.m, gp.sigma j ^ 2 = 1 := by
        intro j; rcases gp.hsigma j with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
      have h_one_sub_eps_sq_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_s_sq : gp.s ^ 2 = 1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2 := by
        simp only [GlobalParams.s]; rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_one_sub_eps_sq_nn]
      
      have hw_tail : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), i.val ≥ t.val → w i = 0 := by
        intro i hi; show (if i.val < t.val then col_p i else (0 : ℝ)) = 0
        simp [show ¬(i.val < t.val) from by omega]
      have hw_head : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), i.val < t.val → w i = col_p i := by
        intro i hi; show (if i.val < t.val then col_p i else (0 : ℝ)) = col_p i; simp [hi]
      
      have h_tail_sum_eq : ‖col_p - w‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1),
          if i.val ≥ t.val then (col_p i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
        have h1 : ‖col_p - w‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), (col_p i - w i) ^ 2 := by
          rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]; congr 1; ext i; simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
        rw [h1]; congr 1; ext i
        by_cases hit : i.val < t.val
        · rw [hw_head i hit, sub_self, sq, mul_zero, if_neg (by omega)]
        · rw [hw_tail i (by omega), sub_zero, if_pos (by omega)]
      
      have h_col_p_entry : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1),
          col_p i = if h : i.val < gp.m then gp.z (Fin.castLT i h) else gp.eta_p := by
        intro i
        simp only [col_p, colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
        change (A gp decomp resP) i (eidx.symm (eidx ColIndex.finalSelected)) = _
        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]; simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_p]
      
      have h_cast : ∀ j : Fin gp.m, col_p (Fin.castSucc j) = gp.z j := by
        intro j
        have hjlt : (Fin.castSucc j).val < gp.m := by rw [Fin.val_castSucc]; exact j.isLt
        rw [h_col_p_entry, dif_pos hjlt]
        have : Fin.castLT (Fin.castSucc j) hjlt = j := by ext; simp [Fin.castLT, Fin.val_castSucc]
        rw [this]
      
      have h_d_sq : ∀ j : Fin gp.m,
          (gp.d j) ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * j.val) := by
        intro j; simp only [GlobalParams.d, mul_pow, ← pow_mul]; congr 1; congr 1; omega
      have h_dt_sq : (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val) :=
        h_d_sq ⟨t.val, ht⟩
      have h_dm_sq : gp.d_m ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (gp.m - 1)) := by
        simp only [GlobalParams.d_m]; exact h_d_sq ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩
      
      suffices h_tail_bound : ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1),
          (if i.val ≥ t.val then (col_p i) ^ 2 else 0) < (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 by
        linarith [h_ub, h_tail_sum_eq]
      
      have h_finm_le : ∑ j : Fin gp.m,
          (if (Fin.castSucc j).val ≥ t.val then (col_p (Fin.castSucc j)) ^ 2 else 0) ≤
          (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by
        
        have hm1 : (⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m) ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin gp.m)) :=
          Finset.mem_univ _
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hm1]
        
        have h_m1cs : (Fin.castSucc (⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m)).val = gp.m - 1 := by
          simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
        rw [h_m1cs, if_pos (show gp.m - 1 ≥ t.val from by omega), h_cast]
        have h_zm1_bnd : (gp.z ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩) ^ 2 ≤
            (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (gp.m - 1)) := by
          simp only [GlobalParams.z,
            if_neg (show ¬((⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m).val < gp.m - 1) from by simp)]
          calc (GlobalParams.gamma_0 * gp.sigma ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ *
                Real.sqrt (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0) * gp.d ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩) ^ 2
              = GlobalParams.gamma_0 ^ 2 * (gp.sigma ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩) ^ 2 *
                (Real.sqrt (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0)) ^ 2 *
                (gp.d ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩) ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0) *
                (gp.d ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩) ^ 2 := by
                rw [h_sigma_sq,
                    Real.sq_sqrt (by rw [show GlobalParams.tau_0 = (1 : ℝ) / 16 from rfl]; norm_num),
                    show GlobalParams.gamma_0 = (1 : ℝ) / 4 from rfl]; ring
            _ ≤ (1 / 16 : ℝ) * 1 * (gp.d ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩) ^ 2 := by
                have : GlobalParams.tau_0 = (1 : ℝ) / 16 := rfl
                nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gp.d ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩)]
            _ = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (gp.m - 1)) := by
                rw [mul_one, h_d_sq]; ring
        
        have h_rest_bound :
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m),
              (if (Fin.castSucc j).val ≥ t.val then (col_p (Fin.castSucc j)) ^ 2 else 0) ≤
            (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 *
              ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (gp.m - 1 - t.val), gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * k) := by
          
          have h_term_eq : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m),
              (if (Fin.castSucc j).val ≥ t.val then (col_p (Fin.castSucc j)) ^ 2 else 0) =
              (if (Fin.castSucc j).val ≥ t.val then
                (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * j.val) else 0) := by
            intro j hj
            have hj_ne := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj
            have hjm1 : j.val < gp.m - 1 := by
              have := j.isLt; simp [Fin.ext_iff] at hj_ne; omega
            by_cases hjcs_ge : (Fin.castSucc j).val ≥ t.val
            · rw [if_pos hjcs_ge, if_pos hjcs_ge, h_cast]
              have hz : gp.z j = GlobalParams.gamma_0 * gp.sigma j * gp.s * gp.d j := by
                simp only [GlobalParams.z, if_pos hjm1]
              rw [hz, show GlobalParams.gamma_0 = (1 : ℝ) / 4 from rfl]
              
              
              have h_exp : (1 / 4 * gp.sigma j * gp.s * gp.d j) ^ 2 =
                  (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (gp.sigma j) ^ 2 * gp.s ^ 2 * (gp.d j) ^ 2 := by ring
              rw [h_exp, h_sigma_sq, h_s_sq, h_d_sq]; ring
            · rw [if_neg hjcs_ge, if_neg hjcs_ge]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_term_eq]
          
          
          rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          
          exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_nbij (fun (j : Fin gp.m) => j.val - t.val)
            (fun j hj => by
              have hj_filt := Finset.mem_filter.mp hj
              have hjcs_ge := hj_filt.2
              have hj_ne := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj_filt.1
              have hjlt := j.isLt
              have hjt : j.val ≥ t.val := by rwa [Fin.val_castSucc] at hjcs_ge
              have hj_ne_val : j.val ≠ gp.m - 1 := by
                intro heq; exact hj_ne (Fin.ext heq)
              exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.sub_lt_sub_right hjt (by omega)))
            (fun j₁ hj₁ j₂ hj₂ heq => by
              have h1' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hj₁)).2
              have h1 : j₁.val ≥ t.val := by rw [Fin.val_castSucc] at h1'; exact h1'
              have h2' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hj₂)).2
              have h2 : j₂.val ≥ t.val := by rw [Fin.val_castSucc] at h2'; exact h2'
              exact Fin.ext (by
                have : t.val + (j₁.val - t.val) = j₁.val := Nat.add_sub_cancel' h1
                have : t.val + (j₂.val - t.val) = j₂.val := Nat.add_sub_cancel' h2
                linarith))
            (fun k hk => by
              have hk_lt := Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hk)
              have hfin : (⟨t.val + k, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m) ∈
                  (Finset.univ.erase (⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m)).filter
                    (fun j => (Fin.castSucc j).val ≥ t.val) :=
                Finset.mem_filter.mpr
                  ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff]; omega, Finset.mem_univ _⟩,
                   show (Fin.castSucc (⟨t.val + k, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m)).val ≥ t.val from by
                     simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]; omega⟩
              exact ⟨⟨t.val + k, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_coe.mpr hfin, by simp⟩)
            (fun j hj => by
              have hjcs_ge := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
              have hjt : j.val ≥ t.val := by rwa [Fin.val_castSucc] at hjcs_ge
              show (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 *
                gp.epsilon ^ (2 * j.val) =
                (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 *
                gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * (j.val - t.val))
              congr 1; congr 1; omega))
        
        have h_tele := geom_telescope gp.epsilon t.val (gp.m - 1 - t.val)
        rw [show 2 * t.val + 2 * (gp.m - 1 - t.val) = 2 * (gp.m - 1) from by omega] at h_tele
        have h_geom : (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) *
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (gp.m - 1 - t.val), gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * k) =
            gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val) - gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (gp.m - 1)) := by linarith
        
        calc (gp.z ⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩) ^ 2 +
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨gp.m - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin gp.m),
                (if (Fin.castSucc j).val ≥ t.val then (col_p (Fin.castSucc j)) ^ 2 else 0)
            ≤ (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (gp.m - 1)) +
              (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (1 - gp.epsilon ^ 2) * gp.alpha ^ 2 *
                ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (gp.m - 1 - t.val), gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val + 2 * k) :=
              add_le_add h_zm1_bnd h_rest_bound
          _ = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * t.val) := by nlinarith [h_geom]
          _ = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by rw [h_dt_sq]; ring
