        have h1 : (-(![7/15, 9/10] ci) * gp.eta_p) ^ 2 = (![7/15, 9/10] ci) ^ 2 * gp.eta_p ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [h1]
        exact mul_lt_of_lt_one_left (sq_pos_of_pos h_eta_pos) h_b_sq_lt
      calc residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.cross ci)) S_t
          ≤ ‖col_c - w‖ ^ 2 := h_ub
        _ = (col_c (Fin.last gp.m)) ^ 2 := h_norm_eq
        _ < gp.eta_p ^ 2 := h_sq_bound
        _ = gp.r := h_eta_sq
        _ ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := h_r_le_piv
  · 
    
    
    
    have h_W_bd := decomp.hW_bound h_idx
    have h_W_pos := decomp.hW_pos h_idx
    
    have h_entry : ∀ i : Fin (gp.m + 1),
        (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)))) i =
          if h' : i.val < gp.m then
            Real.sqrt (decomp.W h_idx) * decomp.u h_idx (Fin.castLT i h')
          else 0 := by
      intro i
      simp only [colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
      change (A gp decomp resP) i (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx))) = _
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp only [A]
    
    set col_v := colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)))
    have h_W_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ decomp.W h_idx := le_of_lt h_W_pos
    have h_first : ∀ j : Fin gp.m, (col_v (Fin.castSucc j)) ^ 2 =
        decomp.W h_idx * (decomp.u h_idx j) ^ 2 := by
      intro j
      have hj_lt : (Fin.castSucc j).val < gp.m := by rw [Fin.val_castSucc]; exact j.isLt
      rw [show col_v (Fin.castSucc j) = _ from h_entry (Fin.castSucc j), dif_pos hj_lt]
      have h_cast : Fin.castLT (Fin.castSucc j) hj_lt = j := by
        ext; simp only [Fin.castLT, Fin.val_castSucc]
      rw [h_cast, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt h_W_nn]
    have h_last_zero : col_v (Fin.last gp.m) = 0 := by
      rw [show col_v (Fin.last gp.m) = _ from h_entry (Fin.last gp.m)]
      rw [dif_neg (show ¬((Fin.last gp.m).val < gp.m) from by simp [Fin.last])]
    have h_norm_sq_eq_W : ‖col_v‖ ^ 2 = decomp.W h_idx := by
      have h_norm : ‖col_v‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), (col_v i) ^ 2 := by
        rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]; congr 1; ext i; simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [h_norm, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp_rw [h_first]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, decomp.hunit h_idx, mul_one, h_last_zero]
      ring
    by_cases ht : t.val < gp.m
    · 
      have h_eps_pos := gp.epsilon_pos
      have h_eps_le_one := gp.epsilon_le_one
      have h_dm_sq_le : gp.d_m ^ 2 ≤ (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by
        have h_dm_le : gp.d_m ≤ gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
          simp only [GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt gp.halpha)
          exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (le_of_lt h_eps_pos) h_eps_le_one (by omega)
        have h_dm_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ gp.d_m := by
          simp only [GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d]
          exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt gp.halpha) (pow_nonneg (le_of_lt h_eps_pos) _)
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h_dm_nn h_dm_le 2
      have h_score_le : residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)) S_t ≤ decomp.W h_idx := by
        have := h_score_le_norm
        show residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)) S_t ≤ decomp.W h_idx
        calc residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)) S_t
            ≤ ‖colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)))‖ ^ 2 := this
          _ = ‖col_v‖ ^ 2 := rfl
          _ = decomp.W h_idx := h_norm_sq_eq_W
      linarith [h_piv_lb_d ht]
    · 
      
      have ht_eq : t.val = gp.m := by omega
      
      have h_col_in_span : col_v ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t := by
        apply prefixSpan_contains_head gp decomp resP t (by omega)
        intro i hi
        have : i.val ≥ gp.m := by omega
        have hi_last : i = Fin.last gp.m := by
          ext; simp [Fin.last]; have := i.isLt; omega
        rw [hi_last]; exact h_last_zero
      have h_ub := residualScore_le_norm_sub_sq Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)) S_t
        col_v h_col_in_span
      have h_norm_diff : ‖col_v - col_v‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by simp
      have h_score_zero : residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)) S_t ≤ 0 := by
        calc residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)) S_t
            ≤ ‖colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx))) - col_v‖ ^ 2 := h_ub
          _ = ‖col_v - col_v‖ ^ 2 := rfl
          _ = 0 := h_norm_diff
      have h_r_pos : (0 : ℝ) < gp.r / 2 := by
        have : gp.r = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.d_m ^ 2 := rfl
        rw [this]
        have h_dm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < gp.d_m := by
          simp only [GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d]
          exact mul_pos gp.halpha (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)
        positivity
      calc residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.frame h_idx)) S_t
          ≤ 0 := h_score_zero
        _ < gp.r / 2 := h_r_pos
        _ ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := h_piv_lb_r
  · 
    exfalso; exact hc_not_res j_res rfl

name: score_lt_pivot
statement:
private lemma score_lt_pivot
    (gp : GlobalParams) (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp)
    (t : Fin (gp.m + 1))
    (c : ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
      if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
    let S_t := pivotPrefix pivots₀ t.val
    eidx c ∉ S_t → eidx c ≠ pivots₀ t →
    residualScore Q₀ (eidx c) S_t < residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ pivots₀ S_t hi hne
  
  have h_selected_is_pivot : ∀ (q : ℕ) (hqm : q < gp.m),
      eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨q, hqm⟩) = pivots₀ ⟨q, by omega⟩ := by
    intro q hqm; show eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨q, hqm⟩) =
      (if h : q < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨q, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected)
    rw [dif_pos hqm]
  
  have h_prefix_last_zero : ∀ s ∈ S_t,
      (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ s)) (Fin.last gp.m) = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_k, rfl⟩ := pivotPrefix_mem_of_bound pivots₀ t.val (by omega) s hs
    have hjm : j < gp.m := by omega
    have hpj : pivots₀ ⟨j, hj_k⟩ = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩) :=
      (h_selected_is_pivot j hjm).symm
    rw [hpj]
    show (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩)))) (Fin.last gp.m) = 0
    simp only [colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col]
    change (A gp decomp resP) (Fin.last gp.m) (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩))) = 0
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    show (A gp decomp resP) (Fin.last gp.m) (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩) = 0
    simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
    have : ¬((Fin.last gp.m).val < gp.m) := by simp [Fin.last]
    rw [dif_neg this]
  
  have h_pivot_score_lb : gp.r / 2 ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
    have h_lb := residualScore_ge_coord_sq Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t (Fin.last gp.m) h_prefix_last_zero
    by_cases ht : (t : ℕ) < gp.m
    · have h_prefix_t_zero : ∀ s ∈ S_t,
          (colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ s)) (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) = 0 := by
        intro s hs
        obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_k, rfl⟩ := pivotPrefix_mem_of_bound pivots₀ t.val (by omega) s hs
        have hjm : j < gp.m := by omega
        have hpj : pivots₀ ⟨j, hj_k⟩ = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩) :=
          (h_selected_is_pivot j hjm).symm
        rw [hpj]
        simp only [colToEuclidean, columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.col, WithLp.equiv]
        change (A gp decomp resP) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩
          (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩))) = 0
        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        simp only [A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
        rw [dif_pos ht]
        simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
        have h_castLT : Fin.castLT (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) ht = ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
          ext; simp [Fin.castLT]
        rw [h_castLT]
        have h_ne : (⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin gp.m) ≠ ⟨j, hjm⟩ := by
          intro heq; simp [Fin.ext_iff] at heq; omega
        have h_not_lt : ¬((⟨t.val, ht⟩ : Fin gp.m).val < (⟨j, hjm⟩ : Fin gp.m).val) := by
          simp; omega
        simp [h_ne, h_not_lt]
      have h_lb_t := residualScore_ge_coord_sq Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t
        (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) h_prefix_t_zero
      have h_piv_val : columnA Q₀ (pivots₀ t) (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) =
          gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
        simp only [columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.col_apply]
        show Q₀ (pivots₀ t) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩ = _
        simp only [Q₀]
        show (A gp decomp resP).transpose
          (eidx.symm (pivots₀ t)) ⟨t.val, by omega⟩ = _
        have hpiv : pivots₀ t = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, ht⟩) := dif_pos ht
        rw [hpiv, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_pq]
        rw [dif_pos ht]
        simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
        have h_castLT2 : Fin.castLT (⟨t.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)) ht = ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
          ext; simp [Fin.castLT]
        rw [h_castLT2]
        simp
      rw [h_piv_val] at h_lb_t
      calc gp.r / 2 ≤ (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 := by
            have h_eps_pos := gp.epsilon_pos
            have h_eps_le_one := gp.epsilon_le_one
            have h_d_nonneg : ∀ (q : Fin gp.m), 0 ≤ gp.d q := fun q => by
              simp only [GlobalParams.d]
              exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt gp.halpha) (pow_nonneg (le_of_lt h_eps_pos) _)
            have h_dm_le : gp.d_m ≤ gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩ := by
              simp only [GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt gp.halpha)
              exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (le_of_lt h_eps_pos) h_eps_le_one (by omega)
            have h_r_le_dm : gp.r / 2 ≤ gp.d_m ^ 2 := by
              have : gp.r = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.d_m ^ 2 := rfl
              rw [this]; have := sq_nonneg gp.d_m; linarith
            have h_sq_mono : gp.d_m ^ 2 ≤ (gp.d ⟨t.val, ht⟩) ^ 2 :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (h_d_nonneg ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩) h_dm_le 2
            linarith
        _ ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := h_lb_t
    · have h_piv_val : columnA Q₀ (pivots₀ t) (Fin.last gp.m) = gp.eta_p := by
        simp only [columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.col_apply]
        show Q₀ (pivots₀ t) (Fin.last gp.m) = _
        simp only [Q₀]
        show (A gp decomp resP).transpose
          (eidx.symm (pivots₀ t)) (Fin.last gp.m) = _
        have hpiv : pivots₀ t = eidx ColIndex.finalSelected := dif_neg ht
        rw [hpiv, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, A, GlobalParams.a_p, Fin.last]
      rw [h_piv_val] at h_lb
      calc gp.r / 2 ≤ gp.eta_p ^ 2 := by
            have h_eq : gp.eta_p ^ 2 = gp.r := by
              simp only [GlobalParams.eta_p, GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.tau_0]
              rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) / 16 ≥ 0)]
            rw [h_eq]
            have : gp.r ≥ 0 := by
              show (1 / 16 : ℝ) * gp.d_m ^ 2 ≥ 0
              positivity
            linarith
        _ ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := h_lb
  
  rcases c with q | _ | ci | h_idx | j_res
  · 
    by_cases hq_lt_t : q.val < t.val
    · exfalso; apply hi; rw [h_selected_is_pivot q.val q.isLt]
      exact pivotPrefix_pivot_mem pivots₀ t.val q.val hq_lt_t (by omega)
    · have hq_ne_t : q.val ≠ t.val := by
        intro h_eq; apply hne; rw [h_selected_is_pivot q.val q.isLt]
        by_cases ht : (t : ℕ) < gp.m
        · congr 1; exact Fin.ext h_eq
        · exfalso; omega
      
      have hq_gt_t : q.val > t.val := Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.not_lt.mp hq_lt_t) (Ne.symm hq_ne_t)
      exact score_selected_lt_pivot gp decomp resP t q hq_gt_t
  · 
    by_cases ht : (t : ℕ) < gp.m
    · exact score_nonselected_lt_pivot gp decomp resP t ColIndex.finalSelected
        (fun q h => by cases h) (fun j h => by cases h) (fun _ => ht)
    · exfalso; apply hne
      show eidx ColIndex.finalSelected =
        (if h : (t : ℕ) < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩) else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected)
      rw [dif_neg ht]
  · exact score_nonselected_lt_pivot gp decomp resP t (ColIndex.cross ci)
      (fun q h => by cases h) (fun j h => by cases h) (fun h => by cases h)
  · exact score_nonselected_lt_pivot gp decomp resP t (ColIndex.frame h_idx)
      (fun q h => by cases h) (fun j h => by cases h) (fun h => by cases h)
  · 
    set a_res := colToEuclidean (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.residual j_res)))
    have h_res_entry : ∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)),
        (columnA Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.residual j_res))) i =
          if i.val < gp.m then 0 else Real.sqrt (resP.theta j_res) := by
      intro i
      simp only [columnA, AMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.col_apply]
      show Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.residual j_res)) i = _
      simp only [Q₀]
      show (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm (eidx (ColIndex.residual j_res))) i = _
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, A]
    have h_ares_coord : ∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)),
        a_res i = if i.val < gp.m then 0 else Real.sqrt (resP.theta j_res) := by
      intro i; show (colToEuclidean _) i = _
      simp [colToEuclidean, WithLp.equiv, h_res_entry i]
    have h_ares_small : ∀ (i : Fin (gp.m + 1)), i.val < gp.m → a_res i = 0 := by
      intro i him; rw [h_ares_coord]; simp [him]
    have h_prefix_span_last_zero : ∀ v ∈ prefixSpan Q₀ S_t,
        (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (gp.m + 1))) (Fin.last gp.m) = 0 :=
      prefixSpan_coord_zero Q₀ S_t (Fin.last gp.m) h_prefix_last_zero
    have h_res_ortho : a_res ∈ (prefixSpan Q₀ S_t)ᗮ := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
      intro w hw
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      by_cases him : i.val < gp.m
      · have : a_res i = 0 := h_ares_small i him
        simp [this]
      · have hi_last : i = Fin.last gp.m := by
          ext; simp [Fin.last]; omega
        rw [hi_last]
        have : w (Fin.last gp.m) = 0 := h_prefix_span_last_zero w hw
        simp [this]
    have h_proj_zero : orthogonalProjector Q₀ S_t a_res = 0 :=
      orthogonalProjector_of_mem_ortho Q₀ S_t a_res h_res_ortho
    have h_score_res : residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.residual j_res)) S_t = ‖a_res‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [residualScore, a_res, h_proj_zero, sub_zero]
    have h_norm_sq_eq_sum : ‖a_res‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin (gp.m + 1), (a_res i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
      congr 1; ext i; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have h_norm_sq_res : ‖a_res‖ ^ 2 = resP.theta j_res := by
      rw [h_norm_sq_eq_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last gp.m)]
      · rw [h_ares_coord]
        simp only [Fin.last, show ¬(gp.m < gp.m) from lt_irrefl _, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (resP.htheta_pos j_res))]
      · intro b _ hb
        have hbm : b.val < gp.m := by
          by_contra h; push Not at h
          have : b = Fin.last gp.m := by ext; simp [Fin.last]; omega
          exact hb this
        rw [h_ares_small b hbm]; simp
      · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
    have h_theta_lt : resP.theta j_res < gp.r / 2 := resP.htheta_lt_cres j_res
    calc residualScore Q₀ (eidx (ColIndex.residual j_res)) S_t
        = ‖a_res‖ ^ 2 := h_score_res
      _ = resP.theta j_res := h_norm_sq_res
      _ < gp.r / 2 := h_theta_lt
      _ ≤ residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := h_pivot_score_lb

name: qrcp_pivot_sequence_proof
statement:
theorem qrcp_pivot_sequence_proof
    (gp : GlobalParams)
    (decomp : Decomposition gp)
    (resP : ResidualParams gp decomp) :
    let eidx
proof:
:= Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
    let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
      fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
    let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
      if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩)
      else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
    IsQRCPPivotSequence Q₀ pivots₀ := by
  intro eidx n₀ Q₀ pivots₀ t
  set S_t := pivotPrefix pivots₀ t.val
  constructor
  · 
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨j, hj_lt, hj_k, heq⟩ := pivotPrefix_mem_of_bound pivots₀ t.val (by omega) (pivots₀ t) hmem
    have hjm : j < gp.m := by omega
    have hpj : pivots₀ ⟨j, hj_k⟩ = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨j, hjm⟩) := dif_pos hjm
    by_cases ht : (t : ℕ) < gp.m
    · have hpt : pivots₀ t = eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, ht⟩) := dif_pos ht
      rw [hpt] at heq; rw [hpj] at heq
      have := eidx.injective heq
      simp [ColIndex.selected.injEq] at this
      omega
    · have hpt : pivots₀ t = eidx ColIndex.finalSelected := dif_neg ht
      rw [hpt] at heq; rw [hpj] at heq
      nomatch eidx.injective heq
  · 
    intro i hi
    by_cases heq : i = pivots₀ t
    · subst heq; exact ⟨le_refl _, fun _ => le_refl _⟩
    · 
      have h_strict : residualScore Q₀ i S_t < residualScore Q₀ (pivots₀ t) S_t := by
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := eidx.surjective i
        exact score_lt_pivot gp decomp resP t c hi heq
      exact ⟨le_of_lt h_strict, fun h_eq => absurd h_eq (ne_of_lt h_strict)⟩

name: residualScore_empty
statement:
theorem residualScore_empty {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    residualScore Q i [] = ∑ j, (Q i j) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold residualScore
  simp only [orthogonalProjector, dite_true, LinearMap.zero_apply, sub_zero]
  unfold colToEuclidean columnA AMatrix
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  congr 1; ext j
  change ‖(Qᵀ.col i) j‖ ^ 2 = Q i j ^ 2
  simp [Matrix.col_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: qrcp_all_rows_le_pivot0
statement:
theorem qrcp_all_rows_le_pivot0 {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (pivots : Fin k → Fin n)
    (hQRCP : IsQRCPPivotSequence Q pivots) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∀ i : Fin n, ∑ j, (Q i j) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (Q (pivots ⟨0, hk⟩) j) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have h := (hQRCP ⟨0, hk⟩).2 i (by simp [pivotPrefix])
  rw [show pivotPrefix pivots (⟨0, hk⟩ : Fin k).val = [] from rfl] at h
  rw [← residualScore_empty, ← residualScore_empty]
  exact h.1

name: qrcp_sup_le_pivot0
statement:
theorem qrcp_sup_le_pivot0 {n k : ℕ} (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (pivots : Fin k → Fin n)
    (hQRCP : IsQRCPPivotSequence Q pivots) (hk : 0 < k)
    [Nonempty (Fin n)] :
    ⨆ i : Fin n, ∑ j, (Q i j) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (Q (pivots ⟨0, hk⟩) j) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  ciSup_le (qrcp_all_rows_le_pivot0 Q pivots hQRCP hk)

name: a_pq_zero_col_norm_sq
statement:
lemma a_pq_zero_col_norm_sq (gp : GlobalParams) :
    ∑ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), (gp.a_pq ⟨0, gp.hm⟩ j) ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h_entry : ∀ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), gp.a_pq ⟨0, gp.hm⟩ j =
      if j.val = 0 then gp.alpha else 0 := by
    intro j
    unfold GlobalParams.a_pq
    split_ifs with h1 hj0
    · unfold GlobalParams.R_beta
      have : Fin.castLT j h1 = ⟨0, gp.hm⟩ := Fin.ext hj0
      simp [this, GlobalParams.d, pow_zero]
    · unfold GlobalParams.R_beta
      have h_ne : ¬(Fin.castLT j h1 = ⟨0, gp.hm⟩) :=
        fun h => hj0 (congrArg Fin.val h)
      simp [h_ne]
    · have := gp.hm; omega
    · rfl
  simp_rw [h_entry]
  have : ∀ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), j ≠ ⟨0, by omega⟩ →
      (if (j : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val = 0 then gp.alpha else (0 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have : j.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h)
    simp [this]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨0, by omega⟩ (fun b _ hb => this b hb)
    (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h)]
  simp

name: obstruction_theorem
statement:
theorem obstruction_theorem
    (H_star : ℝ) (hH : H_star > 1)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : B > 0)
    (e : ℝ) (he : e ≥ 0)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : K ≥ 1) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (_ : k ≥ K)
      (n : ℕ) (_ : n > k)
      (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
      (pivots : Fin k → Fin n)
      (hInv : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q pivots)),
      Q.transpose * Q = 1 ∧
      IsQRCPPivotSequence Q pivots ∧
      (selectedMatrix Q pivots).det ≠ 0 ∧
      mu Q < H_star ∧
      gamma Q pivots hInv / Real.sqrt (k * (n - k + 1 : ℝ)) > B * (k : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨eta, heta_pos, heta_bound⟩ :
      ∃ eta : ℝ, eta > 0 ∧ Real.exp (2 * eta) < H_star := by
    set f := fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * x) with hf_def
    have hf_cont : Continuous f :=
      Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id')
    have hf_zero : f 0 < H_star := by
      simp only [hf_def, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]; linarith
    have hf_open : IsOpen {x | f x < H_star} := hf_cont.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Iio
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff] at hf_open
    obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_ball⟩ := hf_open 0 hf_zero
    exact ⟨ε / 2, by linarith, hε_ball (by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
      simp only [sub_zero, abs_of_pos (by linarith : ε / 2 > 0)]; linarith)⟩
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨M_bsns, hMb_ge2, hMb_cond⟩ := bsns_threshold_exists eta heta_pos B hB e he
  
  have hC_pos : B * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) > 0 :=
    mul_pos hB (Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (by positivity))
  obtain ⟨M_bsns2, hMb2_ge2, hMb2_cond⟩ :=
    bsns_threshold_exists eta heta_pos
      (B * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3)) hC_pos (e + 1) (by linarith)
  
  have hMu_gap : H_star - Real.exp (2 * eta) > 0 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨m, hm_pos, hm_ge2, hm_K, hm_large, hm_eta_raw, hm_mu, hm_bsns_raw, hm_bsns2_raw⟩ :
      ∃ m : ℕ, m > 0 ∧ m ≥ 2 ∧ m + 1 ≥ K ∧
      (↑m : ℝ) > 30 ∧
      (↑m : ℝ) > eta + 2 ∧
      (↑m + 33 : ℝ) / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) +
        5 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 < H_star ∧
      (let eps := Real.exp (-eta / (↑m + 1))
       let s_val := Real.sqrt (1 - eps ^ 2)
       let roe := (1 + s_val / 2) / eps
       let alpha := 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)
       s_val ^ 2 * 15 * roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) >
         64 * alpha ^ 2 * eps ^ 2 *
         ((B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2)))) ∧
      (let eps := Real.exp (-eta / (↑m + 1))
       let s_val := Real.sqrt (1 - eps ^ 2)
       let roe := (1 + s_val / 2) / eps
       let alpha := 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)
       s_val ^ 2 * 15 * roe ^ (2 * (m - 2)) >
         64 * alpha ^ 2 * eps ^ 2 *
         ((B * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ (e + 1)) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2)))) := by
    have hEta_bd : ∃ N : ℕ, (N : ℝ) > eta + 2 := exists_nat_gt (eta + 2)
    obtain ⟨N5, hN5⟩ := hEta_bd
    
    
    have hMu_bd : ∃ N : ℕ, (N : ℝ) > (32 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5) / (H_star - Real.exp (2 * eta)) :=
      exists_nat_gt _
    obtain ⟨N6, hN6⟩ := hMu_bd
    have hm_mu_aux : ∀ n : ℕ, (↑N6 : ℝ) ≤ ↑n → n ≥ 2 →
        ((↑n : ℝ) + 33) / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) +
          5 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 < H_star := by
      intro n hn hn2
      have h_n1_pos : (↑n : ℝ) + 1 > 0 := by positivity
      have hE_pos : Real.exp (2 * eta) > 0 := Real.exp_pos _
      
      have h_ratio : ((↑n : ℝ) + 33) / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) = 1 + 32 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [h_ratio]
      
      suffices h : 32 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 <
          H_star - Real.exp (2 * eta) by linarith
      
      have h_n1_large : (↑n : ℝ) + 1 > (32 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5) / (H_star - Real.exp (2 * eta)) := by
        linarith
      have h_key : (32 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5) < ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) * (H_star - Real.exp (2 * eta)) :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ hMu_gap).mp h_n1_large
      
      have h_lhs_bound : 32 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤
          (32 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5) / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) := by
        rw [add_div]
        have h1 : 32 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) = 32 * Real.exp (2 * eta) / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
        rw [h1]
        have h2 : 5 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 5 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num : (5:ℝ) > 0).le h_n1_pos
          nlinarith
        linarith
      calc 32 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5 / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2
          ≤ (32 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5) / ((↑n : ℝ) + 1) := h_lhs_bound
        _ < H_star - Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
            rw [div_lt_iff₀ h_n1_pos]; linarith
    refine ⟨max (max (max (max (max (max (K - 1) M_bsns) M_bsns2) 31) N5) N6) 2,
      by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, by apply hMb_cond; omega, by apply hMb2_cond; omega⟩
    · 
      exact_mod_cast show (max (max (max (max (max (max (K - 1) M_bsns) M_bsns2) 31) N5) N6) 2 : ℕ) > 30 from by omega
    · 
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hN5 (Nat.cast_le.mpr (by omega))
    · 
      exact hm_mu_aux _ (Nat.cast_le.mpr (by omega)) (by omega)
  
  
  
  have hm1_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (↑m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  let gp : GlobalParams := {
    H_star := H_star, hH_star := hH,
    B := B, hB := hB,
    e := e, he := he,
    K := K, hK := hK,
    eta := eta, heta_pos := heta_pos, heta_bound := heta_bound,
    m := m, hm := hm_pos, hk := hm_K,
    alpha := 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1), halpha := div_pos one_pos hm1_pos_real,
    sigma := fun _ => 1, hsigma := fun _ => Or.inl rfl }
  
  
  
  have h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta := by
    apply Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet
    have h_ut : gp.R_beta.BlockTriangular id := by
      intro i j hij; change j < i at hij
      simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · subst h1; exact absurd hij (lt_irrefl _)
      · exact absurd h2 (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hij))
      · rfl
    rw [Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular h_ut]
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => by
      simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta, ite_true]
      exact ne_of_gt (by
        simp only [GlobalParams.d, GlobalParams.epsilon]
        exact mul_pos gp.halpha (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _))))
  have hm_bsns : gp.s ^ 2 * (15 : ℝ) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) >
      64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2 *
      ((B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2))) :=
    hm_bsns_raw
  have h_bsns_dominates := bsns_growth_dominates gp h_inv_R B e hB he rfl rfl m rfl hm_pos
    hm_ge2 hm_bsns
  
  
  
  have h_sym : gp.M_rem.IsHermitian := by
    ext i j
    simp only [GlobalParams.M_rem, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
      Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
      star_trivial, smul_eq_mul, @eq_comm _ i j, mul_comm (gp.z j) (gp.z i)]
    congr 1; congr 1; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => mul_comm _ _
  have h_alpha_m_small : gp.alpha ^ 2 * ↑gp.m ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    change (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 * (↑m : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4
    rw [div_pow, one_pow, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 > 0) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((↑m : ℝ) - 1)]
  have h_pd : gp.M_rem.PosDef :=
    M_rem_posDef gp h_sym h_alpha_m_small hm_ge2
  let decomp := decomp_from_spectral gp h_sym h_pd
  
  
  
  have h_eigensum_pos : (∑ h : Fin gp.m, h_sym.eigenvalues h : ℝ) > 0 := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin gp.m) := ⟨⟨0, hm_pos⟩⟩
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun h _ => M_rem_eigenvalues_pos gp h_sym h_pd h) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have h_r_pos : gp.r > 0 := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d, GlobalParams.epsilon]; positivity
  have hmu_res_pos : 1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * gp.r > 0 := by
    have h_alpha_lt : gp.alpha < 1 := by
      change (1 : ℝ) / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) < 1
      rw [div_lt_one hm1_pos_real]; linarith [show (↑m : ℝ) ≥ 1 from by exact_mod_cast hm_pos]
    have h_eps_pos : gp.epsilon > 0 := Real.exp_pos _
    have h_eps_lt : gp.epsilon < 1 := by
      change Real.exp _ < 1; rw [Real.exp_lt_one_iff]
      exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have h_dm_lt : gp.d_m < 1 := by
      calc gp.d_m = gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ (gp.m - 1) := rfl
        _ ≤ gp.alpha * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (pow_le_one₀ (le_of_lt h_eps_pos) (le_of_lt h_eps_lt)) (le_of_lt gp.halpha)
        _ < 1 := by rw [mul_one]; exact h_alpha_lt
    have h_r_lt : gp.r < 1 / 16 := by
      have : gp.r = 1 / 16 * gp.d_m ^ 2 := rfl; rw [this]
      have h_dm_pos : gp.d_m > 0 := mul_pos gp.halpha (pow_pos h_eps_pos _)
      nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_dm_lt h_dm_pos]
    have : GlobalParams.kappa_eta < 3 := by unfold GlobalParams.kappa_eta; norm_num
    nlinarith
  have h_r_half_pos : gp.r / 2 > 0 := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d, GlobalParams.epsilon]; positivity
  set J_res := Nat.ceil (1 / (gp.r / 2)) + 1 with hJ_res_def
  have hJ_res_pos_nat : J_res > 0 := by change Nat.ceil _ + 1 > 0; omega
  have hJ_res_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (↑J_res : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hJ_res_pos_nat
  have h_one_div_J_lt : (1 : ℝ) / ↑J_res < gp.r / 2 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hJ_res_pos]
    have hceil : (1 / (gp.r / 2) : ℝ) ≤ ↑(Nat.ceil (1 / (gp.r / 2))) := Nat.le_ceil _
    have hstep : (↑(Nat.ceil (1 / (gp.r / 2))) : ℝ) < ↑J_res := by
      simp only [hJ_res_def]; push_cast; linarith
    calc gp.r / 2 * ↑J_res > gp.r / 2 * (1 / (gp.r / 2)) := by nlinarith
      _ = 1 := mul_one_div_cancel (ne_of_gt h_r_half_pos)
  let resP : ResidualParams gp decomp := {
    J := J_res,
    theta := fun _ => (1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * gp.r) / ↑J_res,
    htheta_pos := fun _ => div_pos hmu_res_pos hJ_res_pos,
    htheta_lt_cres := fun _ => by
      calc (1 - GlobalParams.kappa_eta * gp.r) / ↑J_res
          ≤ 1 / ↑J_res := by
            apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt hJ_res_pos)
            have : GlobalParams.kappa_eta > 0 := by unfold GlobalParams.kappa_eta; norm_num
            linarith [mul_pos this h_r_pos]
        _ < gp.r / 2 := h_one_div_J_lt,
    hmu_res_pos := hmu_res_pos,
    hsum_theta := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hJ_res_pos),
  }
  
  
  
  set n₀ := Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J) with hn₀_def
  have hn₀_card : n₀ = m + 3 + decomp.H + J_res := by
    simp only [hn₀_def]
    rw [colIndex_card, show gp.m = m from rfl]
  have h_denom_pos : (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) *
      ((↑(Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)) : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1) > 0 := by
    rw [show Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J) = n₀ from rfl, hn₀_card]
    have hH_pos : decomp.H > 0 := by
      change gp.m * N_split gp > 0
      exact Nat.mul_pos hm_pos (by unfold N_split; omega)
    push_cast; nlinarith
  
  have hdm2_pos : gp.d_m ^ 2 > 0 :=
    sq_pos_of_pos (mul_pos gp.halpha (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _))
  have heps_pow_lower : gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 1)) > Real.exp (-2 * eta) := by
    rw [show gp.epsilon = Real.exp (-eta / (↑m + 1)) from rfl, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    apply Real.exp_strictMono
    rw [show (↑(2 * (m - 1)) : ℝ) = 2 * ((↑m : ℝ) - 1) from by
      rw [show (2 * (m - 1) : ℕ) = 2 * m - 2 from by omega,
          Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * m)]; push_cast; ring]
    rw [show 2 * ((↑m : ℝ) - 1) * (-eta / (↑m + 1)) = -2 * eta * ((↑m - 1) / (↑m + 1)) from by ring]
    have h_ratio_lt : ((↑m : ℝ) - 1) / (↑m + 1) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one (by positivity : (↑m : ℝ) + 1 > 0)]; linarith
    nlinarith
  have h_eps_exp_prod : gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 1)) * Real.exp (2 * eta) > 1 := by
    calc gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 1)) * Real.exp (2 * eta)
        > Real.exp (-2 * eta) * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
          nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (2 * eta)]
      _ = Real.exp ((-2 * eta) + (2 * eta)) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ = 1 := by norm_num
  have hdm2_eq : gp.d_m ^ 2 = 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 1)) := by
    have h1 : gp.d_m = (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)) * gp.epsilon ^ (m - 1) := rfl
    rw [h1, mul_pow, div_pow, one_pow, ← pow_mul, show (m - 1) * 2 = 2 * (m - 1) from by omega]
  have h_inv_dm2 : 1 / (gp.d_m ^ 2) < ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
    rw [hdm2_eq]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (show 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 1)) > 0 from by
      apply mul_pos (div_pos one_pos (by positivity : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 > 0))
      exact pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)]
    calc ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) * (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 1)))
        = gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 1)) * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by field_simp
      _ > 1 := h_eps_exp_prod
  have hN_upper : (↑(N_split gp) : ℝ) < ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 2 := by
    have h1 : (↑(N_split gp) : ℝ) < 1 / (gp.d_m ^ 2) + 2 := by
      change (↑(Nat.ceil (1 / (gp.d_m ^ 2)) + 1) : ℝ) < _
      push_cast
      linarith [Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg one_pos.le (le_of_lt hdm2_pos))]
    linarith
  have hH_bound : (↑decomp.H : ℝ) < (↑m : ℝ) * (((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 2) := by
    rw [show decomp.H = m * N_split gp from rfl, Nat.cast_mul]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hN_upper (by exact_mod_cast hm_pos)
  have hJ_upper : (↑J_res : ℝ) < 32 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 2 := by
    have h1 : (↑J_res : ℝ) < 1 / (gp.r / 2) + 2 := by
      change (↑(Nat.ceil (1 / (gp.r / 2)) + 1) : ℝ) < _
      push_cast
      linarith [Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg one_pos.le (le_of_lt h_r_half_pos))]
    have h2 : 1 / (gp.r / 2) = 32 / (gp.d_m ^ 2) := by
      change 1 / (GlobalParams.tau_0 * gp.d_m ^ 2 / 2) = 32 / (gp.d_m ^ 2)
      unfold GlobalParams.tau_0; field_simp; ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h3 : 32 / (gp.d_m ^ 2) < 32 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) < gp.d_m ^ 2 := hdm2_pos
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ this] at h_inv_dm2 ⊢
      nlinarith [h_inv_dm2]
    linarith
  have h_m32 : (↑m : ℝ) + 32 < 2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have : (↑m : ℝ) > 30 := hm_large; linarith
  have h_bsns_large_gen :
      QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r >
      (B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 *
        ((↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) *
         ((↑(Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)) : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1)) := by
    set B' := B * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) with hB'_def
    have hm_bsns2 : gp.s ^ 2 * (15 : ℝ) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) >
        64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2 *
        ((B' * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ (e + 1)) ^ 2 *
         (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2))) := hm_bsns2_raw
    have h_bsns2 := bsns_growth_dominates_gen gp h_inv_R
      ((B' * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ (e + 1)) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2)))
      m rfl hm_pos hm_ge2 hm_bsns2
    suffices h_dom : (B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 *
        ((↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) * ((↑n₀ : ℝ) - ↑(gp.m + 1) + 1)) ≤
        (B' * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ (e + 1)) ^ 2 *
        (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2)) by
      rw [show Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J) = n₀ from rfl]; linarith
    change (B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 *
        ((↑(m + 1) : ℝ) * ((↑n₀ : ℝ) - ↑(m + 1) + 1)) ≤ _
    have hH_pos : decomp.H > 0 := Nat.mul_pos hm_pos (by unfold N_split; omega)
    have hN_pos : N_split gp > 0 := by unfold N_split; omega
    have h_n0_sub : (↑n₀ : ℝ) - ↑(m + 1) + 1 = (3 : ℝ) + ↑decomp.H + ↑J_res := by
      rw [hn₀_card]; push_cast; ring
    rw [h_n0_sub]
    have hm1_pos_cast : (0 : ℝ) < (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have h_rpow_split : (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ (e + 1) = (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) > 0), Real.rpow_one]
    have h_B'_sq : (B' * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ (e + 1)) ^ 2 =
        B ^ 2 * (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * ((↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : B' * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ (e + 1) =
          B * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * ((↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e * ↑(m + 1)) := by
        rw [hB'_def, h_rpow_split]
      rw [h1, show B * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * ((↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e * ↑(m + 1)) =
          (B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * ↑(m + 1)) from by ring,
          mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow,
          Real.sq_sqrt (show 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3 ≥ 0 from by positivity)]
      ring
    rw [h_B'_sq, show (B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 = B ^ 2 * ((↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 from by ring]
    have hB2_pos : B ^ 2 > 0 := sq_pos_of_pos hB
    have hme2_pos : ((↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 > 0 := sq_pos_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hm1_pos_cast e)
    suffices h_ineq : (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) * ((3 : ℝ) + ↑decomp.H + ↑J_res) ≤
        (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2)) by
      nlinarith
    have hm_r : (↑m : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hm_ge2
    have hexp_pos : Real.exp (2 * eta) > 0 := Real.exp_pos _
    have h_sum_lt : (3 : ℝ) + (↑decomp.H : ℝ) + (↑J_res : ℝ) <
        5 + 2 * (↑m : ℝ) + ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
      nlinarith [hH_bound, hJ_upper]
    have h_m32_E : ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * Real.exp (2 * eta) <
        2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
      have h_pos : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * Real.exp (2 * eta) > 0 := by positivity
      nlinarith [h_m32]
    calc (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) * ((3 : ℝ) + ↑decomp.H + ↑J_res)
        ≤ (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) * (5 + 2 * (↑m : ℝ) + ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta)) := by
          push_cast; nlinarith [h_sum_lt]
      _ ≤ (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2)) := by
          have h_lin : (5 : ℝ) + 2 * (↑m : ℝ) ≤ 6 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((↑m : ℝ) + 1)]
          
          have h_const : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * (5 + 2 * (↑m : ℝ)) ≤ 6 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) := by
            nlinarith
          have h_E_term : ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * Real.exp (2 * eta) ≤
              2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by linarith [h_m32_E]
          have h_sum : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * (5 + 2 * (↑m : ℝ)) + ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * Real.exp (2 * eta) ≤
              6 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) + 2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
            linarith
          have h_rhs_eq : (2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 3) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * (2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2)) =
              4 * Real.exp (2 * eta) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) + 6 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) := by ring
          push_cast
          have hm' : (↑m : ℝ) + 1 > 0 := by positivity
          have hEC : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2) * Real.exp (2 * eta) > 0 := by positivity
          nlinarith [h_sum, h_rhs_eq, hEC]
  let eidx := Fintype.equivFin (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J)
  let Q₀ : Matrix (Fin n₀) (Fin (gp.m + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun i j => (A gp decomp resP).transpose (eidx.symm i) j
  let pivots₀ : Fin (gp.m + 1) → Fin n₀ := fun t =>
    if h : t.val < gp.m then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨t.val, h⟩)
    else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected
  have hInv_inst : Invertible (selectedMatrix Q₀ pivots₀) :=
    selectedMatrix_invertible gp decomp resP
  have hQTQ_proof : Q₀.transpose * Q₀ = 1 :=
    parseval_QTQ_eq_one gp decomp resP
  refine ⟨gp.m + 1, hm_K, n₀, ?n_gt_k, Q₀, pivots₀, hInv_inst,
    hQTQ_proof, ?hQRCP, ?hDet, ?hMu, ?hGamma⟩
  case n_gt_k =>
    change Fintype.card (ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J) > gp.m + 1
    have h_inj : Function.Injective (Sum.elim
        (fun q : Fin gp.m => (ColIndex.selected q : ColIndex gp.m decomp.H resP.J))
        (fun i : Fin 2 => match i with
          | ⟨0, _⟩ => ColIndex.finalSelected
          | ⟨1, _⟩ => ColIndex.cross ⟨0, by omega⟩)) := by
      intro a b hab
      cases a with
      | inl a => cases b with
        | inl b => exact congrArg Sum.inl (ColIndex.selected.inj hab)
        | inr b => fin_cases b <;> simp [Sum.elim] at hab
      | inr a => cases b with
        | inl b => fin_cases a <;> simp [Sum.elim] at hab
        | inr b => fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> first | rfl | (simp [Sum.elim] at hab)
    have := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ h_inj
    simp [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin] at this; omega
  case hQRCP => exact qrcp_pivot_sequence_proof gp decomp resP
  case hDet =>
    haveI := hInv_inst
    exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp (isUnit_of_invertible _) |>.ne_zero
  case hMu =>
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin n₀) := ⟨eidx ColIndex.finalSelected⟩
    
    
    have hP_proj : Q₀ * Q₀.transpose * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) = Q₀ * Q₀.transpose := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Q₀.transpose Q₀ Q₀.transpose,
          hQTQ_proof, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hP_symm_entry : ∀ a b : Fin n₀,
        (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) a b = (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) b a := by
      intro a b
      have hP_symm : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose).transpose = Q₀ * Q₀.transpose := by
        rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
      have := congr_fun (congr_fun hP_symm b) a
      rwa [Matrix.transpose_apply] at this
    have h_row_bound : ∀ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      intro i
      have hP_ii : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i = ∑ j, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 := by
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, sq]
      have hPP_diag : ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 = (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i := by
        have h1 : ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose)) i i =
            ∑ k, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) k i := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
        have h2 : ∑ k, (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k * (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) k i =
            ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 := by
          congr 1; ext k; rw [sq, hP_symm_entry k i]
        linarith [congr_fun (congr_fun hP_proj i) i, h1, h2]
      have hPii_sq_le : (Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i ^ 2 ≤
          ∑ k, ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i k) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      rw [← hP_ii]
      nlinarith [hPP_diag, hPii_sq_le, sq_nonneg ((Q₀ * Q₀.transpose) i i - 1)]
    have h_sup_le : ⨆ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 ≤ 1 :=
      ciSup_le h_row_bound
    
    have h_trace : (∑ i : Fin n₀, ∑ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), (Q₀ i j) ^ 2) = ↑(gp.m + 1) := by
      have : ∀ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), ∑ i : Fin n₀, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        intro j
        have h1 : (Q₀.transpose * Q₀) j j = ∑ i, Q₀ i j * Q₀ i j := by
          simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
        rw [hQTQ_proof] at h1
        simp only [Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h1
        convert h1.symm using 1
        congr 1; ext i; rw [sq]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [this]
      simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    
    
    have hQRCP_local : IsQRCPPivotSequence Q₀ pivots₀ :=
      qrcp_pivot_sequence_proof gp decomp resP
    have h_pivot0_norm :
        ∑ j : Fin (gp.m + 1), (Q₀ (pivots₀ ⟨0, by omega⟩) j) ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2 := by
      change ∑ j, ((A gp decomp resP).transpose
        (eidx.symm (pivots₀ ⟨0, by omega⟩)) j) ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2
      have h_pivot_eq : eidx.symm (pivots₀ ⟨0, by omega⟩) = ColIndex.selected ⟨0, gp.hm⟩ := by
        change eidx.symm (if h : (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val < gp.m
          then eidx (ColIndex.selected ⟨(⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (gp.m + 1)).val, h⟩)
          else eidx ColIndex.finalSelected) = _
        simp [gp.hm, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [h_pivot_eq]
      change ∑ j, (A gp decomp resP j (ColIndex.selected ⟨0, gp.hm⟩)) ^ 2 = gp.alpha ^ 2
      simp only [A]
      exact a_pq_zero_col_norm_sq gp
    have h_sup_alpha : ⨆ i, ∑ j, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2 ≤ gp.alpha ^ 2 := by
      calc ⨆ i, ∑ j, (Q₀ i j) ^ 2
          ≤ ∑ j, (Q₀ (pivots₀ ⟨0, by omega⟩) j) ^ 2 :=
            qrcp_sup_le_pivot0 Q₀ pivots₀ hQRCP_local (by omega)
        _ = gp.alpha ^ 2 := h_pivot0_norm
    
    
    exact coherence_bound_product Q₀ hQTQ_proof H_star (by
      have hm1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) := by positivity
      
      calc ↑n₀ / ↑(gp.m + 1) * (⨆ i, ∑ j, Q₀ i j ^ 2)
          ≤ ↑n₀ / ↑(gp.m + 1) * gp.alpha ^ 2 := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sup_alpha
              (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hm1_pos))
        _ < H_star := by
          
          have h_alpha_eq : gp.alpha = 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) := rfl
          have h_alpha_sq : gp.alpha ^ 2 = 1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
            rw [h_alpha_eq, div_pow, one_pow]
          rw [show (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) = (↑m : ℝ) + 1 from by push_cast; ring, h_alpha_sq]
          have hm1_pos' : (↑m : ℝ) + 1 > 0 := by positivity
          rw [show (↑n₀ : ℝ) / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) =
              (↑n₀ : ℝ) / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 from by
                rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_one]
                congr 1; ring]
          
          have hn₀_upper : (↑n₀ : ℝ) < 3 * (↑m : ℝ) + 5 + ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
            rw [hn₀_card]; push_cast; nlinarith [hH_bound, hJ_upper]
          
          have hm1_pos_r : (↑m : ℝ) + 1 > 0 := by positivity
          have hm1_cube_pos : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 > 0 := by positivity
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ hm1_cube_pos]
          have hE_pos : Real.exp (2 * eta) > 0 := Real.exp_pos _
          
          have hn₀_upper : (↑n₀ : ℝ) < 3 * (↑m : ℝ) + 5 + ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
            rw [hn₀_card]; push_cast; nlinarith [hH_bound, hJ_upper]
          have hn₀_lt : (↑n₀ : ℝ) < 5 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) + ((↑m : ℝ) + 33) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
            have h1 : 3 * (↑m : ℝ) + 5 ≤ 5 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith
            have h2 : ((↑m : ℝ) + 32) ≤ (↑m : ℝ) + 33 := by linarith
            nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) ≥ 0)]
          
          
          have h_Hstar_expand : H_star * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 >
              5 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) + ((↑m : ℝ) + 33) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) := by
            have h1 : H_star * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 >
                (((↑m : ℝ) + 33) / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) +
                 5 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm_mu (by positivity)
            have h2 : (((↑m : ℝ) + 33) / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (2 * eta) +
                 5 / ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 =
                ((↑m : ℝ) + 33) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * eta) + 5 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) := by
              have hm1_ne : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
              have hm1_sq_ne : ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
              field_simp [hm1_ne, hm1_sq_ne]
            linarith
          linarith
    ) (by positivity)
  case hGamma =>
    exact gamma_source_scale_violation gp decomp resP B e hB he rfl rfl m rfl hm_pos
      h_denom_pos h_inv_R h_bsns_large_gen hInv_inst

name: eps_pos
statement: private lemma eps_pos (gp : GlobalParams) : gp.epsilon > 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold GlobalParams.epsilon; exact Real.exp_pos _

name: d_pos
statement: private lemma d_pos (gp : GlobalParams) (i : Fin gp.m) : gp.d i > 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold GlobalParams.d GlobalParams.epsilon
  exact mul_pos gp.halpha (pow_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _)

name: r_pos'
statement: private lemma r_pos' (gp : GlobalParams) : gp.r > 0
proof:
:= by
  change (1 / 16 : ℝ) * (gp.alpha * gp.epsilon ^ (gp.m - 1 : ℕ)) ^ 2 > 0
  exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (sq_pos_of_pos (mul_pos gp.halpha (pow_pos (eps_pos gp) _)))

name: Rx_eq_z
statement:
private lemma Rx_eq_z (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta] :
    gp.R_beta *ᵥ (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) = gp.z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, mul_nonsing_inv gp.R_beta (isUnit_det_of_invertible gp.R_beta), one_mulVec]

name: last_entry_formula
statement:
private lemma last_entry_formula (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta] :
    let last
proof:
:= (⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩ : Fin gp.m)
    (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) last = gp.z last / gp.d last := by
  intro last
  have h_d_ne : gp.d last ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (d_pos gp last)
  have h_entry : ∑ j : Fin gp.m, gp.R_beta last j * (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) j = gp.z last := by
    have := congrFun (Rx_eq_z gp) last
    simp only [mulVec, dotProduct] at this; exact this
  have h_off_diag : ∀ j : Fin gp.m, j ≠ last → gp.R_beta last j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact absurd (h1 ▸ rfl : j = last) hj
    · have : j.val ≤ gp.m - 1 := by omega
      exact absurd (Fin.ext (Nat.le_antisymm this (by omega))) hj
    · rfl
  have h_sum : ∑ j : Fin gp.m, gp.R_beta last j * (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) j =
      gp.R_beta last last * (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) last :=
    Finset.sum_eq_single _ (fun j _ hj => by rw [h_off_diag j hj, zero_mul])
      (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ last) h)
  rw [h_sum, show gp.R_beta last last = gp.d last from by simp [GlobalParams.R_beta]] at h_entry
  rw [eq_div_iff h_d_ne]; linarith

name: last_entry_sq_val
statement:
private lemma last_entry_sq_val (gp : GlobalParams) :
    let last
proof:
:= (⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩ : Fin gp.m)
    (gp.z last / gp.d last) ^ 2 = 15 / 256 := by
  intro last
  have h_d_ne : gp.d last ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (d_pos gp last)
  have h_z : gp.z last = GlobalParams.gamma_0 * gp.sigma last *
      Real.sqrt (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0) * gp.d last := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.z, show ¬(last.val < gp.m - 1) from by simp [last], ite_false]
  rw [h_z, mul_div_cancel_of_imp (fun h => absurd h h_d_ne)]
  have h_sigma_sq : gp.sigma last ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rcases gp.hsigma last with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  simp only [GlobalParams.gamma_0, GlobalParams.tau_0]
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - 1/16), h_sigma_sq]
  norm_num

name: bsns_ge_entry_sq
statement:
private lemma bsns_ge_entry_sq (gp : GlobalParams) (h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta)
    (i : Fin gp.m) :
    QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R ≥
      ((gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _))]
  simp_rw [show ∀ j : Fin gp.m,
    ‖((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin gp.m) ℝ).symm (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z)).ofLp j‖ ^ 2 =
    ((gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) j) ^ 2 from fun j => by simp [EuclideanSpace.equiv]]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: x_sq_eq_y_sq
statement:
private lemma x_sq_eq_y_sq (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta] (i : Fin gp.m) :
    ((gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) i) ^ 2 = (y_entry gp i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold y_entry
  have h_sigma_sq : gp.sigma i ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rcases gp.hsigma i with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  rw [mul_pow, h_sigma_sq, one_mul]

name: s_pos
statement: private lemma s_pos (gp : GlobalParams) : gp.s > 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold GlobalParams.s; apply Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos
  have h1 : gp.epsilon < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr
    (div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith [gp.heta_pos]) (by positivity))
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg gp.epsilon, eps_pos gp]

name: row_eq_y_form
statement:
private lemma row_eq_y_form (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta] (i : Fin gp.m) :
    gp.d i * gp.sigma i * y_entry gp i -
    GlobalParams.beta * gp.sigma i * gp.s * gp.d i *
      (∑ j : Fin gp.m, if i.val < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0) = gp.z i
proof:
:= by
  have h_sigma_sq : ∀ k : Fin gp.m, gp.sigma k ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro k; rcases gp.hsigma k with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have h_x_eq : ∀ j : Fin gp.m, (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) j = gp.sigma j * y_entry gp j := by
    intro j; unfold y_entry
    have : gp.sigma j * (gp.sigma j * (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) j) =
      gp.sigma j ^ 2 * (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) j := by ring
    rw [this, h_sigma_sq, one_mul]
  have h_row : ∑ j : Fin gp.m, gp.R_beta i j * (gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) j = gp.z i := by
    have h := congrFun (Rx_eq_z gp) i; simp only [mulVec, dotProduct] at h; exact h
  simp_rw [h_x_eq] at h_row
  have h_term : ∀ j : Fin gp.m,
      gp.R_beta i j * (gp.sigma j * y_entry gp j) =
      (if i = j then gp.d i * (gp.sigma i * y_entry gp i) else 0) +
      (if i.val < j.val then -(GlobalParams.beta * gp.sigma i * gp.s * gp.d i) * y_entry gp j else 0) := by
    intro j
    simp only [GlobalParams.R_beta]
    by_cases h1 : i = j
    · subst h1; simp
    · simp only [h1, ite_false, zero_add]
      split_ifs with h2
      · linear_combination -(GlobalParams.beta * gp.sigma i * gp.s * gp.d i * y_entry gp j) * (h_sigma_sq j)
      · ring
  rw [show ∑ x, gp.R_beta i x * (gp.sigma x * y_entry gp x) =
      ∑ j, ((if i = j then gp.d i * (gp.sigma i * y_entry gp i) else 0) +
      (if i.val < j.val then -(GlobalParams.beta * gp.sigma i * gp.s * gp.d i) * y_entry gp j else 0))
    from Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => h_term j)] at h_row
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq _ _ _, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ i)] at h_row
  have h_factor : ∑ x : Fin gp.m,
      (if i.val < x.val then -(GlobalParams.beta * gp.sigma i * gp.s * gp.d i) * y_entry gp x else 0) =
      -(GlobalParams.beta * gp.sigma i * gp.s * gp.d i) *
      ∑ x : Fin gp.m, (if i.val < x.val then y_entry gp x else 0) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]; congr 1; ext j; split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [h_factor] at h_row; linarith

name: y_recurrence
statement:
private lemma y_recurrence (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta]
    (i : Fin gp.m) (hi : i.val < gp.m - 1) :
    y_entry gp i = gp.s / 4 + (gp.s / 2) * ∑ j : Fin gp.m, if i.val < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_sigma_ne : gp.sigma i ≠ 0 := by rcases gp.hsigma i with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have h_d_ne : gp.d i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (d_pos gp i)
  have h_z : gp.z i = GlobalParams.gamma_0 * gp.sigma i * gp.s * gp.d i := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.z, show i.val < gp.m - 1 from hi, ite_true]
  have h_eq := row_eq_y_form gp i
  rw [h_z] at h_eq
  
  
  suffices h_zero : gp.d i * gp.sigma i * (y_entry gp i - gp.s / 4 - (gp.s / 2) *
    ∑ j : Fin gp.m, if i.val < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0) = 0 by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_zero with h1 | h2
    · exact absurd h1 (mul_ne_zero h_d_ne h_sigma_ne)
    · linarith
  unfold GlobalParams.beta GlobalParams.gamma_0 at h_eq
  nlinarith

name: y_base_pos
statement:
private lemma y_base_pos (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta] :
    y_entry gp ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩ > 0
proof:
:= by
  set last := (⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩ : Fin gp.m)
  unfold y_entry
  rw [last_entry_formula gp]
  have h_d_pos : gp.d last > 0 := d_pos gp last
  have h_z : gp.z last = GlobalParams.gamma_0 * gp.sigma last *
      Real.sqrt (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0) * gp.d last := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.z, show ¬(last.val < gp.m - 1) from by simp [last], ite_false]
  rw [h_z, mul_div_cancel_of_imp (fun h => absurd h (ne_of_gt h_d_pos))]
  have h_sigma_sq : gp.sigma last ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rcases gp.hsigma last with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have h_sigma_mul : gp.sigma last * (GlobalParams.gamma_0 * gp.sigma last * Real.sqrt (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0))
      = GlobalParams.gamma_0 * (gp.sigma last ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0) := by ring
  rw [h_sigma_mul, h_sigma_sq, mul_one]
  simp only [GlobalParams.gamma_0, GlobalParams.tau_0]
  positivity

name: y_base_sq
statement:
private lemma y_base_sq (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta] :
    (y_entry gp ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩) ^ 2 = 15 / 256
proof:
:= by
  set last := (⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩ : Fin gp.m)
  unfold y_entry
  have h_sigma_sq : gp.sigma last ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rcases gp.hsigma last with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  rw [mul_pow, h_sigma_sq, one_mul]
  rw [last_entry_formula gp]
  have h_d_ne : gp.d last ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (d_pos gp last)
  have h_z : gp.z last = GlobalParams.gamma_0 * gp.sigma last *
      Real.sqrt (1 - GlobalParams.tau_0) * gp.d last := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.z, show ¬(last.val < gp.m - 1) from by simp [last], ite_false]
  rw [h_z, mul_div_cancel_of_imp (fun h => absurd h h_d_ne)]
  simp only [GlobalParams.gamma_0, GlobalParams.tau_0]
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - 1/16), h_sigma_sq]
  norm_num

name: y_zero_lower
statement:
private lemma y_zero_lower (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta]
    (hs_pos : gp.s > 0) (hm_ge2 : gp.m ≥ 2) :
    y_entry gp ⟨0, by omega⟩ ≥ (gp.s / 2) * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (gp.m - 2) *
      y_entry gp ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hρ_pos : (1 : ℝ) + gp.s / 2 > 0 := by linarith
  have hs2_pos : gp.s / 2 > 0 := by linarith
  set y_last := y_entry gp ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩
  let tail : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ∑ j : Fin gp.m, if k < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0
  have hm1_pos : (0 : ℕ) < gp.m - 1 := by omega
  have h_y0 : y_entry gp ⟨0, by omega⟩ = gp.s / 4 + (gp.s / 2) * tail 0 :=
    y_recurrence gp ⟨0, by omega⟩ hm1_pos
  have h_tail_split : ∀ k : ℕ, (hk : k + 1 < gp.m) →
      tail k = y_entry gp ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ + tail (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk; change ∑ j : Fin gp.m, (if k < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0) =
      y_entry gp ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ + ∑ j : Fin gp.m, (if k + 1 < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => show (if k < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0) =
      (if j.val = k + 1 then y_entry gp j else 0) + (if k + 1 < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0) from by
      rcases lt_trichotomy j.val (k + 1) with h | h | h
      · simp [show ¬(k < j.val) from by omega, show j.val ≠ k + 1 from by omega, show ¬(k + 1 < j.val) from by omega]
      · simp [h]
      · simp [show k < j.val from by omega, show j.val ≠ k + 1 from by omega, h]),
      Finset.sum_add_distrib]; congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => show (if j.val = k + 1 then y_entry gp j else 0) =
      (if j = ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ then y_entry gp j else 0) from by
      congr 1; exact propext ⟨fun h => Fin.ext h, fun h => congrArg Fin.val h⟩),
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  have h_tail_base : tail (gp.m - 2) = y_last := by
    change ∑ j : Fin gp.m, (if gp.m - 2 < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0) = y_last
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => show
      (if gp.m - 2 < j.val then y_entry gp j else 0) =
      (if j = ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩ then y_entry gp j else 0) from by
      by_cases hj : j.val = gp.m - 1
      · rw [if_pos (show gp.m - 2 < j.val from by omega), if_pos (Fin.ext hj)]
      · rw [if_neg (show ¬(gp.m - 2 < j.val) from by have := j.isLt; omega),
            if_neg (show j ≠ ⟨gp.m - 1, _⟩ from fun h => hj (congrArg Fin.val h))]),
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  have h_tail_ind : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ gp.m - 2 → tail (gp.m - 2 - n) ≥ (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ n * y_last := by
    intro n hn; induction n with
    | zero => simp [h_tail_base]
    | succ n ih =>
      have ih' := ih (by omega)
      have hk1 : (gp.m - 2 - (n + 1)) + 1 < gp.m := by omega
      have h_split := h_tail_split (gp.m - 2 - (n + 1)) hk1
      have hk1_val : (gp.m - 2 - (n + 1)) + 1 = gp.m - 2 - n := by omega
      have hk1_lt_m1 : (⟨(gp.m - 2 - (n + 1)) + 1, hk1⟩ : Fin gp.m).val < gp.m - 1 := by simp; omega
      have h_rec := y_recurrence gp ⟨(gp.m - 2 - (n + 1)) + 1, hk1⟩ hk1_lt_m1
      have h_tail_eq : tail (gp.m - 2 - (n + 1)) = gp.s / 4 + (1 + gp.s / 2) * tail ((gp.m - 2 - (n + 1)) + 1) := by
        rw [h_split, h_rec]; ring
      rw [hk1_val] at h_tail_eq
      calc tail (gp.m - 2 - (n + 1))
          = gp.s / 4 + (1 + gp.s / 2) * tail (gp.m - 2 - n) := h_tail_eq
        _ ≥ 0 + (1 + gp.s / 2) * ((1 + gp.s / 2) ^ n * y_last) := by
            linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih' (le_of_lt hρ_pos)]
        _ = (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (n + 1) * y_last := by ring
  have h_tail_0 : tail 0 ≥ (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (gp.m - 2) * y_last := by
    have := h_tail_ind (gp.m - 2) (le_refl _); rwa [Nat.sub_self] at this
  calc y_entry gp ⟨0, by omega⟩
      = gp.s / 4 + (gp.s / 2) * tail 0 := h_y0
    _ ≥ 0 + (gp.s / 2) * ((1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (gp.m - 2) * y_last) := by
        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tail_0 (le_of_lt hs2_pos)]
    _ = (gp.s / 2) * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (gp.m - 2) * y_last := by ring

name: y_zero_sq_lower
statement:
private lemma y_zero_sq_lower (gp : GlobalParams) [Invertible gp.R_beta]
    (hs_pos : gp.s > 0) (hm_ge2 : gp.m ≥ 2) :
    (y_entry gp ⟨0, by omega⟩) ^ 2 ≥
      (gp.s / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (2 * (gp.m - 2)) *
      (y_entry gp ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set y_last := y_entry gp ⟨gp.m - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos gp.hm⟩
  set y_0 := y_entry gp ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have h := y_zero_lower gp hs_pos hm_ge2
  have hA : (gp.s / 2) * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (gp.m - 2) * y_last > 0 :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) (pow_pos (by linarith) _)) (y_base_pos gp)
  calc y_0 ^ 2
      ≥ ((gp.s / 2) * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (gp.m - 2) * y_last) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq' (by linarith) h
    _ = (gp.s / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (2 * (gp.m - 2)) * y_last ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: backSubstNormSq_exponential_lower
statement:
private lemma backSubstNormSq_exponential_lower (gp : GlobalParams)
    (h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta) (m : ℕ) (hm_eq : gp.m = m) (hm_ge2 : m ≥ 2) :
    QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R ≥
      (gp.s / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (2 * (m - 2)) * (15 / 256 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_bsns_ge := bsns_ge_entry_sq gp h_inv_R ⟨0, by omega⟩
  
  have h_eq := x_sq_eq_y_sq gp ⟨0, by omega⟩
  
  have hs := s_pos gp
  have hm_eq' : gp.m ≥ 2 := by omega
  have h_y0_sq := y_zero_sq_lower gp hs hm_eq'
  
  have h_base := y_base_sq gp
  
  rw [h_base] at h_y0_sq
  rw [show gp.m - 2 = m - 2 from by omega] at h_y0_sq
  calc QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R
      ≥ ((gp.R_beta⁻¹ *ᵥ gp.z) ⟨0, by omega⟩) ^ 2 := h_bsns_ge
    _ = (y_entry gp ⟨0, by omega⟩) ^ 2 := h_eq
    _ ≥ (gp.s / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (2 * (m - 2)) * (15 / 256 : ℝ) := h_y0_sq

name: bsns_div_r_ge_exponential
statement:
private lemma bsns_div_r_ge_exponential (gp : GlobalParams)
    (h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta) (m : ℕ) (hm_eq : gp.m = m) (hm_ge2 : m ≥ 2)
    (h_bsns_lower : QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R ≥
      (gp.s / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (2 * (m - 2)) * (15 / 256 : ℝ)) :
    QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r ≥
      gp.s ^ 2 * (15 : ℝ) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) /
      (64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h_r_pos := r_pos' gp
  suffices h2 : (gp.s / 2) ^ 2 * (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (2 * (m - 2)) * (15 / 256 : ℝ) / gp.r =
      gp.s ^ 2 * (15 : ℝ) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) /
      (64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2) by
    linarith [div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_bsns_lower (le_of_lt h_r_pos)]
  have h_r : gp.r = 1 / 16 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * (gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 2)) * gp.epsilon ^ 2) := by
    simp only [GlobalParams.r, GlobalParams.d_m, GlobalParams.d]
    rw [← pow_add, show 2 * (m - 2) + 2 = 2 * (gp.m - 1) from by omega]; ring
  have hε := ne_of_gt (eps_pos gp)
  have key : (1 + gp.s / 2) ^ (2 * (m - 2)) =
      gp.epsilon ^ (2 * (m - 2)) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) := by
    unfold rho_over_eps; rw [div_pow, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ hε)]
  rw [h_r, key, div_eq_div_iff
    (ne_of_gt (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/16) (sq_pos_of_pos gp.halpha))
      (mul_pos (pow_pos (eps_pos gp) _) (sq_pos_of_pos (eps_pos gp)))))
    (ne_of_gt (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 64) (sq_pos_of_pos gp.halpha))
      (sq_pos_of_pos (eps_pos gp))))]
  ring

name: bsns_growth_dominates_gen
statement:
theorem bsns_growth_dominates_gen
    (gp : GlobalParams) (h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta)
    (rhs : ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (hm_eq : gp.m = m) (hm_pos : m > 0) (hm_ge2 : m ≥ 2)
    (hm_bsns : gp.s ^ 2 * (15 : ℝ) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) >
        64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2 * rhs) :
    QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r > rhs
proof:
:= by
  have h_bsns_lower := backSubstNormSq_exponential_lower gp h_inv_R m hm_eq hm_ge2
  have h_div := bsns_div_r_ge_exponential gp h_inv_R m hm_eq hm_ge2 h_bsns_lower
  have h_denom_pos : 64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2 > 0 :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 64) (sq_pos_of_pos gp.halpha))
      (sq_pos_of_pos (eps_pos gp))
  have h_rhs : rhs < gp.s ^ 2 * (15 : ℝ) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) /
      (64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos]; linarith
  subst hm_eq; linarith

name: bsns_growth_dominates
statement:
theorem bsns_growth_dominates
    (gp : GlobalParams) (h_inv_R : Invertible gp.R_beta)
    (B e : ℝ) (_hB : B > 0) (_he : e ≥ 0)
    (_hB_eq : gp.B = B) (_he_eq : gp.e = e)
    (m : ℕ) (hm_eq : gp.m = m) (hm_pos : m > 0) (hm_ge2 : m ≥ 2)
    (hm_bsns : gp.s ^ 2 * (15 : ℝ) * rho_over_eps gp ^ (2 * (m - 2)) >
        64 * gp.alpha ^ 2 * gp.epsilon ^ 2 *
        ((B * (↑(m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 * (2 * (↑m + 1) * (↑m + 2)))) :
    QRCPProof.SelectedBlock.backSubstNormSq gp.R_beta gp.z h_inv_R / gp.r >
        (B * (↑(gp.m + 1) : ℝ) ^ e) ^ 2 *
          (2 * ((↑m : ℝ) + 1) * ((↑m : ℝ) + 2))
proof:
:= by
  subst hm_eq
  exact bsns_growth_dominates_gen gp h_inv_R _ gp.m rfl hm_pos hm_ge2 hm_bsns
